title: Senior Data Architect
description:
**Job Description**
CSS Innovation Studios is seeking Senior Data Engineers/Architects with deep expertise in PySpark and data engineering to deliver strategic AI and data-transformation programs for Oracle’s largest enterprise customers.
  
  
In this senior, customer-facing role, you will design, build, modernize, and operationalize enterprise-scale data platforms and AI-driven data solutions on Oracle AI Data Platform (AIDP) and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). You will work directly with CIOs, CDOs, CTOs, chief architects, engineering leaders, and Oracle product teams to accelerate AI adoption, modernize legacy data estates, and deliver secure, high-performing production solutions.
  
  
The role combines hands-on software and data engineering with technical consulting. You will develop scalable systems supporting generative AI, large language models, real-time analytics, and modern data workloads; lead complex platform implementations and migrations; and partner with architects, product managers, and engineers to apply and evolve Oracle product capabilities through real-world customer deployments.
  
  

* 10–12+ years of experience designing, architecting, and delivering enterprise-scale data platforms.
* Proven experience as a Senior Data Engineer, Data Architect, Principal Solution Architect, Consulting Engineer, or technical leader in professional services.
* Expert knowledge of one or more modern cloud data platforms like Databricks
* Extensive hands-on experience with Apache Spark, PySpark, Delta Lake, Python, SQL, Scala or Java, Kafka and modern data ecosystems.
* Exposure to building autonomous agents and orchestration pipelines.
* Deep expertise in Spark architecture, configuration, distributed systems, performance engineering, optimization, and tuning at scale.
* Demonstrated success modernizing enterprise analytics platforms and refactoring Spark and ETL workloads.
* Must have a solid understanding of networking concepts to design and optimize data transmission networks, configure network settings, and diagnose and resolve network-related issues.
* Strong understanding of DataOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, data security, governance, metadata, lineage, and observability.
* Outstanding executive communication, customer advisory, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Responsibilities**
Lead architecture and delivery of enterprise Oracle AI Data Platform transformations, including platform implementations and migrations.
  
  

* Design and build scalable, governed, AI-ready data architectures, software components, and services for data consolidation, integration, transformation, and data products.
* Develop Lakehouse, Medallion, streaming, and real-time analytics solutions on OCI using technologies such as Spark, PySpark, Delta Lake, Parquet, Flink, and distributed-systems patterns.
* Build AI/ML and Generative AI data pipelines, including feature engineering, feature extraction, MLOps workflows, and vector-ready datasets.
* Assess and modernize workloads by refactoring PySpark and ETL code and optimizing Spark configuration, cluster sizing, partitioning, memory, adaptive query execution, reliability, and performance at scale.
* Develop APIs, SDKs, web applications, and automation frameworks that simplify adoption of Oracle AI Data Platform and Generative AI services.
* Create reusable migration accelerators, reference architectures, automation frameworks, and delivery methodologies.
* Collaborate with engineering, product, and field teams to solve complex technical challenges; share customer insights to inform product roadmaps.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor throughout customer engagements.
* Mentor senior engineers globally, promote engineering excellence across CSS, and continuously evaluate emerging AI, cloud, and data-engineering practices.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: AI / ML internship in degradation modelling for Li-ion batteries
description:
**We’re hiring: AI/ML Engineering Intern at Bridgegreen Upcycle, Chennai 🔋**

Predicting how a second-life battery will age is a hard problem. Getting it right decides whether a repurposed pack is a reliable product or a warranty liability.

At Bridgegreen Upcycle, we’re building the data and modelling foundation to answer that question for real batteries in the field. We're looking for an intern who wants to work where machine learning, physics, electrochemistry and engineering insights meet.

**What you’ll do**

* Clean, validate, and analyse real-world battery datasets
* Improve our ML models through structured experiments, benchmarking, and cross-validation
* Build feature engineering and numerical modelling pipelines
* Read battery and electrochemistry literature and turn it into better models
* Keep your experiments reproducible, with clean code, Git, and clear write-ups

**Who you are**

* A final-year or current Master’s student in CS, AI, Data Science, Physics, Applied Maths, or EE/ME/ChemE
* Strong in Python, with solid ML fundamentals and comfortable with numerical methods
* You’ve built at least one project in PyTorch using CUDA/GPU, whether personal, academic, or hobby
* Curious about how batteries actually degrade, and happy to work on open-ended R&D problems

**What you’ll get**

Hands-on work with real battery data, exposure to scientific ML and physics-informed modelling, and close mentorship on problems that go straight into products.

📍 On-site at our Recharge Center, Marai Malai Nagar, Chennai

⏳ 3 months | Starts immediately

**To apply:**
Send your CV and a GitHub link or project write-up to info@bridgegreenupcycle.com. Please include JDI-014 in the subject line.

#Hiring #Internship #MachineLearning #ScientificML #BatteryTechnology #SecondLife #LFP #EnergyStorage #Chennai #PyTorch

title: Principal Engineer - Machine Learning
description:
**About Freshworks:**

Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.

**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**

Freshworks Inc. builds uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional employee and customer experiences. Our people-first approach to AI eliminates friction, helping businesses reduce complexity, lower cost-to-serve, and deliver faster, more human support through enterprise-grade yet easy-to-use CX and IT solutions. Nearly 75,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks to power their Employee Experience (EX) and Customer Experience (CX) operations.

**Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

**Job Description**

**About the Role:**
Freshworks is building next-generation AI-driven customer and employee engagement platforms. As a Principal Engineer - Machine Learning on our AI/ML Engineering team, you will drive the architecture and technical strategy for core backend services powering our Agentic AI Platform. You will lead the development of reasoning-driven agents, multi-agent orchestration, and outcome-based workflows that directly power autonomous AI capability across our suite of enterprise products. This role is pivotal in establishing engineering standards, scaling backend infrastructure, and mentoring senior engineers as we expand our agentic capabilities at enterprise scale.

**What You'll Do**

* Drive Platform & Runtime Architecture: Lead the architectural design and execution of agent runtime orchestration services, focusing on reasoning, planning, tool invocation, and low-latency execution.
* Define API & SDK Standards: Design and establish robust, developer-friendly APIs and SDKs that enable internal engineering teams and external ecosystem partners to build, deploy, and manage complex agent workflows.
* Architect Stateful & Memory Systems: Build and optimize stateful dialog management, shared context systems, and memory services for multi-turn, context-aware autonomous agents.
* Implement Multi-Agent Communication Protocols: Establish scalable agent-to-agent (A2A) communication protocols, coordination patterns, and shared memory spaces for distributed multi-agent workflows.
* Lead Cloud-Native Microservices Migration: Drive the transition toward cloud-native, event-driven backend services using modern microservices, service mesh, and event-streaming architectures.
* Optimize LLM Performance & Cost Efficiency: Design and implement LLM orchestration optimizations—including semantic caching, dynamic batching, token monitoring, and intelligent model routing—to ensure high performance and cost governance.
* Own Integrations & Observability: Direct the implementation of enterprise RAG pipelines, vector database integrations (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS), and deep LangSmith/OpenTelemetry tracing for end-to-end evaluation and visibility.
* Drive Technical Excellence & Mentorship: Establish rigorous standards for automated testing (unit, integration, load), tenant isolation (RBAC, multi-tenancy), and provide technical mentorship to elevate engineering capabilities across the team.

**Qualifications**

**Must Have:**

* Experience: 12–18 years of progressive software engineering and machine learning system development experience, with a track record of architecting scalable enterprise backend systems.
* Technical Mastery: Deep proficiency in Java and Python, with hands-on expertise building production systems using agentic orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith) and workflow engines (e.g., Temporal, Airflow).
* Distributed Systems Expertise: Advanced understanding of event-driven architectures, microservices, Kubernetes, Kafka, AWS cloud infrastructure, and mixed database paradigms (PostgreSQL, Vector DBs).
* Execute with Excellence: Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, solve complex architectural bottlenecks, anticipate technical risks, and connect cross-functional dependencies to deliver high-impact engineering initiatives at scale.
* Lead with Vision & Strategy: Demonstrated capability in translating complex business and AI goals into actionable long-term platform roadmaps while influencing technical decisions across cross-functional engineering partners.
* Cultivate a Growth Mindset: A track record of identifying innovative tools, challenging assumptions, and driving technical continuous improvement across the broader engineering organization.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with AI-driven planning systems, dialog state tracking, or reinforcement learning feedback loops in production environments.
* Hands-on experience with enterprise security frameworks, including SSO, OAuth2, RBAC, and multi-tenant data isolation.
* Active involvement in open-source AI/ML projects or contributions to major LLM/orchestration libraries.

**Additional Information**

**Please note this is a hybrid role that requires an in-office presence 3 days / week (Tue-Thu).**

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business.
**Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

You will be hands-on in developing autonomous AI agents, large language model (LLM) pipelines, and reinforcement learning engines that optimize customer lifecycles, automate complex workflows, and drive measurable business value. You will also serve as a technical lead on high-impact projects, mentoring junior engineers and shaping our internal AI engineering standards.

* Develop prescriptive optimization engines using Reinforcement Learning (RL), Contextual Bandits, or mathematical optimization to power real-time "Next Best Action" (NBA) and dynamic pricing recommendations.
* Apply causal inference and uplift modeling techniques to measure and optimize the true incremental impact of AI-driven interventions.
* Production Engineering & MLOps
* Collaborate with MLOps and Data Engineering teams to deploy machine learning and agentic models into highly scalable, low-latency production environments.
* Write production-grade, optimized code (Python) and build robust API endpoints for AI service integration.
* Design and maintain telemetry for monitoring model drift, agent hallucination rates, and overall system performance.

* Mentor Engineer I and II team members, conduct rigorous code/model reviews, and foster a culture of continuous learning.

* Engineering Best Practices: Experience with cloud computing platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines for ML.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience building AI engines specifically for Base Management, Marketing Tech, or Customer Value Management (CVM).
* Experience with Causal Machine Learning (DoWhy, EconML).
* Active contributor to open-source AI projects or a portfolio demonstrating complex agentic workflow development.

Where you’ll be working

40

To work as a member of a team, encouraging team building, motivation and cultivating effective team relations.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or an equivalent numerate discipline

title: Chief Technology Officer
description:
About Moative

Moative is an AI diffusion company. We partner with midmarket companies in asset-heavy, regulated industries to co-build deeply industry-specific agentic and machine learning solutions, which then get diffused across the industry through revenue-share and equity-linked models.

**Our Past**

: We have built and sold two companies, one of which was an AI company. Our founders and leaders are Math PhDs, Ivy League University Alumni, Ex-Googlers, and successful entrepreneurs.

**Team**

: Our team of 20+ employees consists of data scientists, AI/ML Engineers, and mathematicians from top engineering and research institutes such as IITs, CERN, IISc, UZH. Our team includes academicians, IBM Research Fellows, and former founders. This role leads technology for our healthcare business, working alongside forward-deployed engineers, data scientists and revenue cycle operators to build an AI management services organization (AI MSO) for US healthcare practices.

Work you’ll do

We are building an AI management services organization (AI MSO) for US healthcare practices. We combine operational expertise, data infrastructure and AI to manage and improve revenue cycle and administrative workflows. We automate suitable tasks progressively, with clear controls and human accountability for exceptions and consequential decisions.

As CTO, you will own the technology strategy, platform architecture and engineering organization behind this business. You will work with our founders, practice owners and billing leaders to decide what to build, which workflows to prioritize and how to measure results. You will remain hands-on in architecture, prototypes, code reviews and difficult production problems.

You will build a reusable platform that connects practice systems, supports reliable automation and captures operational learning across engagements, while maintaining appropriate separation of each practice’s data. The work includes payer-portal agents, voice-based payer follow-up, claim-journey analysis, denial management and payment-posting workflows.

Technical leads will own day-to-day pod delivery within the direction you set. You will resolve major technical trade-offs, develop those leaders and remain accountable for platform quality, reliability and technical risk.

Responsibilities

* Own technology strategy, platform architecture and engineering standards for the healthcare AI MSO.
* Work with founders, practice owners and billing leaders to assess workflows, establish baselines and prioritize investments by business value, feasibility and dependencies.
* Lead product and platform decisions, balancing practice-specific requirements with capabilities that can be reused across customers and specialties.
* Design solutions across EHRs, practice-management systems, clearinghouses and payer portals, connecting data pipelines, AI agents and operator workflows.
* Define the practice data architecture, integrating claims, remittances, EOBs, denial codes and operational records into validated, traceable data with clear access controls and isolation between practices.
* Separate operational data that requires patient identifiers from de-identified analytical datasets, and define approved uses of each.
* Stay hands-on through architecture and code reviews, targeted prototypes and resolution of complex production issues.
* Make build-versus-buy, vendor and model decisions based on reliability, security, cost and business value.
* Establish technical controls for healthcare privacy, security and compliance, working with legal, compliance and client stakeholders on approved data flows, retention, vendor access and incident response.
* Set production evaluation and release criteria, including monitoring, human escalation, recovery procedures and ownership of failures.
* Own engineering and infrastructure budgets, platform operating costs and investment in reusable capabilities.
* Hire, develop and retain engineers, data scientists and technical leads, with clear accountability for quality and delivery.
* Represent Moative’s technology with practice owners, partners and investors, explaining technical choices and their implications for practice economics.

Who you are

You are a technology leader who has built products and remains close to engineering. You can decide what to build with a practice owner, examine an architecture with an engineer and explain investment choices to an executive or investor.

You have worked with fragmented operational systems, inconsistent data and workflows that depend on people’s judgment. You investigate how work is actually done before deciding what to automate, and you understand that reliable data and clear processes are foundations for useful AI.

You have built and scaled products or a technology business, made decisions with incomplete information and stayed accountable for customer adoption and commercial outcomes. You can develop strong technical leaders while stepping into difficult engineering problems when needed.

You want to build the technology foundation of an AI MSO and take responsibility for how it performs as the business grows.

Skills & Requirements

Must have

* At least 15 years of relevant engineering and technology leadership experience, with recent hands-on involvement in architecture, solution design, prototyping and production troubleshooting.
* Experience building and scaling a product or technology business in a founding, CTO or senior engineering leadership role, with clear evidence of customer adoption, commercial outcomes and your own contribution.
* Experience owning product and technology decisions from customer discovery through production, adoption and ongoing improvement.
* Deep experience integrating, cleaning and modeling fragmented operational data, including building reusable platforms serving multiple customers with clear data isolation and access boundaries.
* Experience leading teams that deploy and support AI in live operations, including LLM-based applications or agents, with evaluation, monitoring and human escalation.
* Strong Python, SQL and cloud architecture skills across at least one platform—AWS, Azure or GCP—with the ability to review code, challenge designs and build prototypes.
* Experience delivering healthcare or RCM products, with practical understanding of billing workflows, claim submission, payer interactions, denials, appeals and payment posting.
* Experience establishing technical controls for sensitive healthcare data, including access management, audit trails, secure logging, vendor access and incident response.
* Experience building engineering and data teams, hiring senior technical leaders and establishing engineering standards.
* Experience owning technology budgets, vendor decisions and operating costs, and explaining investment trade-offs in business terms.
* Experience working directly with CXOs, founders and investors to agree priorities, resolve conflicting expectations and communicate technical risk.
* Ability to demonstrate a product you chose to build, the architecture and team you developed, the trade-offs you made and the results achieved.

Preferred experience

* Experience building for US outpatient practices, MSOs or RCM companies, including working with US billing teams and payer workflows.
* Experience taking a company through an acquisition, merger or other successful exit, including technical diligence and transition responsibilities.
* Experience turning services engagements or client-specific solutions into reusable products and platforms.
* Experience with healthcare data exchange and integrations involving claims, remittances, EHRs, practice-management systems or clearinghouses.
* Experience with process mining, operational knowledge systems or adapting smaller models for domain-specific tasks.
* Experience building browser automation or voice agents for operational workflows.

**Location: Chennai or Bangalore.**

Chennai preferred. This role involves regular in-person collaboration with our founders and the healthcare AI pod.

Working at Moative

Moative is a young company, but we believe strongly in thinking long-term, while acting with urgency. Our ethos is rooted in innovation, efficiency and high-quality outcomes. We believe the future of work is AI-augmented and boundaryless. Here are some of our guiding principles:

* **Think in decades. Act in hours.**

  As an independent company, our moat is time. While our decisions are for the long-term horizon, our execution will be fast – measured in hours and days, not weeks and months.
* **Own the canvas.**

  Throw yourself in to build, fix or improve – anything that isn’t done right, irrespective of who did it. Be selfish about improving across the organization – because once the rot sets in, we waste years in surgery and recovery.
* **Use data or don’t use data.**

  Use data where you ought to but not as a ‘cover-my-back’ political tool. Be capable of making decisions with partial or limited data. Get better at intuition and pattern-matching. Whichever way you go, be mostly right about it.
* **Avoid work about work**

  . Process creeps on purpose, unless we constantly question it. We are deliberate about committing to rituals that take time away from the actual work. We truly believe that a meeting that could be an email, should be an email and you don’t need a person with the highest title to say that out loud.
* **High revenue per person.**

  We work backwards from this metric. Our default is to automate instead of hiring. We multi-skill our people to own more outcomes than hiring someone who has less to do. We don’t like squatting and hoarding that comes in the form of hiring for growth. High revenue per person comes from high quality work from everyone. We demand it.

We’d love to hear about a product you helped build and scale, ideally in healthcare or another regulated, data-intensive industry—covering the customer problem, key decisions, team, challenges, results, and your role. Founding or exit experience is welcome. Please share only authorized information; anonymized examples work well.

title: Manager - Navigation & Control
description:
**About Planys Technologies**

Planys Technologies is a next-gen defence technology startup building intelligent autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) and maritime robotic systems that give naval and security forces a real-time, machine-driven picture of the undersea battlespace. Inspired by the pace, ambition, and product mindset of modern defence innovators, we are designing persistent, ROVs, AUVs, and hybrid surface vessel edge-compute heavy payloads, and advanced undersea sensing that turn oceans into knowledgeable, navigable, and defendable environments.

Engineers and researchers work like full-stack product teams: shaping hydrodynamics and propulsion, architecting navigation and perception stacks, and building autonomy and mission-systems software that must perform in GPS-denied, low-comms, high-risk conditions. You will see your code and hardware leave the lab quickly, iterate through real sea trials, and plug into high-impact naval, coastal security, and strategic deterrence missions in India and beyond. You’ll be part of a small, high-caliber team empowered to move fast, take end-to-end ownership, and push the boundaries of what underwater systems can sense, decide, and achieve in one of the most demanding environments on Earth.

**Job Description**

We are looking for a Manager – Navigation & Control to design, develop, integrate, and validate navigation and control systems for autonomous underwater vehicles.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Design and implement navigation algorithms (INS, DVL, USBL aiding, EKF/UKF sensor fusion) for AUV platforms operating in GPS-denied environments.
* Develop and tune guidance and control systems, including autopilots, path-following (LOS, Pure Pursuit), station-keeping, and depth/heading controllers.
* Build high-fidelity simulation environments for algorithm validation, including Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing.
* Integrate and calibrate navigation sensors, including IMU, DVL, USBL, pressure sensors, and magnetometers, on vehicle hardware.
* Implement real-time GNC software on embedded Linux platforms with deterministic timing requirements.
* Develop harbour-to-harbour navigation, mission planning, and waypoint management modules, and integrate them with the vehicle autonomy stack.
* Analyse and resolve navigation and control anomalies using sea-trial data, and drive post-trial reviews.
* Define and execute verification and validation (V&V) plans for GNC subsystems against system-level requirements.
* Support system-level integration, sea trials, and field deployments, and troubleshoot vehicle behaviour on-site.
* Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, and software teams on vehicle-level design trade-offs and interface definitions.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including algorithm design documents, test reports, and calibration procedures.
* Create and track team work plans, mentor junior engineers, and provide technical guidance.

**Required Skills**

* Strong mathematical and analytical background.
* Strong knowledge of navigation, estimation, sensor fusion, and control systems.
* Proficiency in C/C++ and Python.
* Experience with ROS/ROS2, Linux, Git, and simulation tools.
* Knowledge of INS, DVL, USBL, EKF/UKF, PID, LQR/MPC.
* Experience with robotic or autonomous systems.
* Strong problem-solving and teamwork skills.

**Qualification**

* M.Tech / M.S. / Ph.D. in Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Ocean Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Robotics, or related fields.
* 4–8 years of relevant experience in navigation, guidance, and control for robotic/autonomous systems.
* Experience in marine or underwater robotics is preferred.
* Research/thesis experience in navigation, control, or state estimation is an added advantage.

* Strong problem-solving, communication, stakeholder management, and analytical skills
* Ability to work effectively with business stakeholders, data scientists, AI engineers, and product teams.

* Prior consulting, strategy, transformation, product management, or technology advisory experience

title: C++ Architect
description:
****Career Area:****
Engineering
  
  
****Job Description:****
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
Role Definition
  
  
Leads the design, development, testing, and architectural oversight of safety‑critical autonomy applications; collaborates with cross‑functional teams to meet internal and external needs.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Designing safety‑critical features end‑to‑end — translating requirements into technical designs for sensor data processing, object detection, threat assessment, and automated safety responses
* Guiding teams on real‑time embedded software design practices, ensuring components are modular, testable, and maintainable.
* Documenting architecture specifications, software design descriptions, verification plans, test cases, operating procedures, and safety procedures.
* Supporting developers in building and validating detection and decision‑making algorithms across multiple vehicle and machine configurations
* Utilizing appropriate tools to debug, test, and maintain software and hardware systems, leading verification and validation activities.
* Lead design and code reviews with focus on safety, correctness, numerical stability, and handling of degraded or missing data

Degree Requirement
  
  

* Requires a degree in Electronic/Electrical Engineering or Computer Science curriculum.
* More than 10 years of relevant industry experience in developing C++ applications

Skill Descriptors
  
  
Real‑Time Systems Integration
  
  
Knowledge of real‑time system architecture and multi‑system integration across sensing, compute, and actuation domains.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Designs and validates end‑to‑end data flows meeting real‑time latency and throughput requirements.
* Integrates software across CAN, Ethernet, and middleware in multi‑ECU architectures.
* Diagnoses timing, synchronization, and data‑consistency issues in distributed systems.
* Defines interface contracts including schemas, timing budgets, and failure modes.
* Evaluates system‑level trade‑offs between compute load, bandwidth, and safety margins.

Artificial Intelligence & Sensor Fusion
  
  
Knowledge of AI and sensor fusion concepts and methods, with awareness of applicable industry standards and safety expectations; ability to develop and apply perception and prediction algorithms for autonomous systems.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Designs and implements sensor fusion pipelines integrating radar, camera, and lidar data into a unified world model.
* Develops and tunes object detection, tracking, and prediction algorithms for real‑time autonomous decision‑making in safety‑critical contexts.
* Evaluates trade‑offs between algorithmic accuracy, latency, computational cost, and system‑level safety constraints on embedded platforms.
* Applies probabilistic and statistical techniques to noisy sensor data, accounting for uncertainty and failure modes.
* Supports validation of perception and prediction systems against ground truth, field data, and applicable standards or guidelines.
* Mentors others on integrating AI/ML components into safety‑critical software architectures.

Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
  
  
Knowledge of SDLC methodologies with ability to deliver, validate, and manage high‑quality software products.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Applies multiple vendor‑provided or in‑house SDLC methodologies with testing embedded across all phases.
* Converts requirements into robust, reviewable designs with explicit verification and testability considerations.
* Leads activities across all SDLC phases including design, implementation, integration, testing, validation, and release.
* Defines and executes test strategies, plans, and cases to validate functionality, error handling, reliability, and failure modes.
* Evaluates and consults on effective SDLC and testing practices using iterative and agile approaches.

Software Development
  
  
Knowledge of programming languages, tools, and Linux‑based development; ability to design, implement, debug, and maintain software for embedded and distributed systems.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Designs and develops software on Linux platforms, including embedded and system‑level components.
* Applies modern C++ (C++11/14/17), including concurrency, RAII, smart pointers, and memory‑safe patterns, in Linux environments.
* Uses Linux debugging and profiling tools to diagnose functional and performance issues.
* Oversees large development efforts aligned with system and architectural design.
* Evaluates programming trade‑offs across performance, memory, safety, and maintainability.
* Coaches junior engineers on programming best practices and Linux workflows.

Problem Solving & Technical Troubleshooting
  
  
Knowledge of structured problem‑solving methods and advanced troubleshooting techniques across organizational, hardware, software, and system domains; ability to resolve high‑impact issues.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Leads structured problem resolution and root‑cause analysis for complex, high‑impact issues.
* Analyzes complex technical problems and applies appropriate diagnostic techniques based on context and impact.
* Resolves critical or wide‑impact hardware, software, and communication failures.
* Drives urgency, prioritization, and decision‑making based on business impact.
* Directs cross‑team and multi‑vendor issue resolution and coach others on advanced troubleshooting techniques.

Additional Information
  
  
This position requires working onsite five days a week.

October 22, 2026 - November 29, 2026
  
  
Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

title: Data Product Engineer
description:
At U.S. Bancorp India, we’re on a journey to do our best. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.
  
  
**Job Description**
The Data Product Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and operating scalable, reusable, and trusted data products that power business intelligence, advanced analytics, AI/ML solutions, and operational decision-making. This role combines modern data engineering practices with product thinking to build high-quality data assets that are discoverable, governed, and reusable across the enterprise. The engineer partners with business stakeholders, product managers, architects, data scientists, and platform teams to deliver data products that align with strategic business outcomes.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, deploy, and maintain enterprise data products and reusable data assets.
* Build scalable batch, streaming, and event-driven data pipelines.
* Create domain-oriented data products that support analytics, reporting, operational processes, and AI initiatives.
* Develop semantic models and curated datasets to enable self-service analytics capabilities.
* Design and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines for structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data.
* Integrate data from enterprise platforms, APIs, and cloud-based systems.
* Implement scalable ingestion, transformation, and orchestration frameworks.
* Build resilient solutions that support enterprise-scale data processing and consumption. Implement data quality validation, observability, monitoring, and remediation processes.
* Ensure data accuracy, completeness, timeliness, consistency, and reliability.

* Develop solutions using modern cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or similar environments.
* Leverage data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, Synapse, Fabric, Redshift, or BigQuery.

* Implement secure access controls and data protection standards.
* Support regulatory, audit, and risk management requirements.
* Contribute to data cataloging, metadata management, and lineage
* Implement CI/CD pipelines and DevOps/DataOps best practices.
* Create technical documentation, architectural diagrams, support guides, and operational runbooks.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Experience / Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or related field.
* 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, Data Product Development, or related disciplines.
* Strong SQL expertise and proficiency in Python, Scala, Java, or similar development languages.
* Experience building modern ETL/ELT pipelines and data integration solutions.
* Hands-on experience with Azure, AWS, or cloud-native data platforms.
* Experience with Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, Redshift, BigQuery, or equivalent platforms.
* Strong understanding of Data Modeling, Data Warehousing, Metadata Management, Data Quality, Cloud Architecture, Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile methodologies.

- 11 AM - 8 PM

**high-impact research, industry collaboration, sponsored projects, consultancy, international partnerships and technology-led innovation**

**academia, industry, advanced engineering and emerging AI technologies**
.

Position

**Professor / Senior Faculty – Robotics & Artificial Intelligence**

  .

* Significant experience working with or collaborating with
  **leading global robotics, AI, automation and technology companies**
  .
* International academic or research experience.
* A strong record of
  **externally funded and industry-sponsored research**
  .
* Experience in
  **technology development and real-world deployment of robotics and AI systems**
  .
* Successful
  **technology commercialisation / technology transfer / startup incubation**
  experience.
* Experience building
  **industry-funded laboratories or Centres of Excellence**
  .
* Experience in academic administration, department leadership or institutional development.

Key Responsibilities

The selected candidate will be expected to:

1. **Lead and strengthen applied research**
   in Robotics and Artificial Intelligence.
2. Develop large-scale
   **industry-sponsored and government-funded research programs**
   .
3. Build strategic partnerships with leading national and international companies and universities.
4. Drive
   **consultancy, technology development and industry projects**
   .
5. Establish new
   **robotics and AI laboratories, Centres of Excellence and multidisciplinary research groups**
   .

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA - Semantic BI - Senior
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Consulting - Data and Analytics - Semantic BI Engineer – Senior**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY's financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY's Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalise on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client's decision-making.
  
  
**Role : Semantic BI Engineer**
**Experience Guide : 3-7 Years**
**Primary Skill Area :**
Semantic Analytics, Self-Service BI, Dashboards, AI-Enabled Insights & Decision Intelligence
  
  
**The opportunity**
Design, build and advise on enterprise BI and semantic analytics solutions that convert trusted data into actionable business insights. This role is not limited to dashboard development; the candidate must be able to assess business needs, propose the right dashboarding or self-service reporting tools, design semantic data layers, build high-quality dashboards, and enable next-generation AI-assisted analytics experiences. The role combines analytics engineering, semantic layer design, dashboard architecture, BI strategy, data storytelling, data modelling, AI enablement and strong business analysis capability.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* BI Strategy, Tool Evaluation & Solution Advisory
* Assess business reporting, analytics and self-service consumption needs across user personas, maturity levels, governance requirements and operating constraints.
* Evaluate and recommend the right BI, dashboarding and self-service reporting tools based on scalability, semantic layer fit, governance, cost, user adoption, integration capability and AI-readiness.
* Shape enterprise BI and analytics roadmaps across Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst and other modern analytics platforms.
* Advise stakeholders on when to use operational reporting, executive dashboards, self-service analytics, semantic search, conversational BI, embedded analytics or AI-assisted insight discovery.
* Semantic Layer & Analytics Engineering
* Design semantic data layers that separate business logic from physical data structures and allow consistent consumption across dashboards, reporting tools, AI assistants and self-service analytics platforms.
* Define governed business metrics, KPIs, measures, dimensions, hierarchies, calculations, data definitions and reusable analytical entities.
* Develop analytics engineering assets using SQL, dbt-style transformation patterns, Fabric semantic models, Power BI datasets, lakehouse/warehouse tables and curated analytical data products.
* Align semantic models with business glossaries, metadata, lineage, data quality rules, access controls and enterprise governance standards.
* Dashboard Development, Architecture & Data Storytelling
* Design and develop high-quality dashboards, scorecards and analytical reports that support executive decisions, operational monitoring, root-cause analysis and business performance tracking.
* Apply dashboard design principles including KPI hierarchy, drill-through, guided navigation, narrative flow, visual consistency, usability, accessibility and performance optimisation.
* Build dashboards using tools such as Power BI, Fabric, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst or equivalent enterprise BI platforms.
* Move beyond visualisation by translating patterns, trends and exceptions into actionable business insights, recommendations and decision support.
* Data Modelling, Data Analysis & Insight Generation
* Apply strong data modelling skills including dimensional modelling, star schema design, semantic modelling, analytical data product modelling, metric modelling and data mart design.
* Perform deep data analysis using SQL, analytical thinking, data profiling, reconciliation, segmentation, trend analysis, variance analysis and root-cause investigation.
* Partner with business SMEs, data engineers, data architects and product owners to convert business questions into robust data models, analytical logic and reusable reporting assets.
* Ensure insights are grounded in trusted data, explainable logic, meaningful context and clear business interpretation.
* AI-Enabled Analytics & Next-Generation BI
* Understand where and how AI can improve analytics workflows, including natural language querying, automated insight generation, anomaly detection, narrative summaries, semantic search and guided analysis.
* Enable AI-assisted analytics using capabilities such as Fabric Copilot, Power BI Copilot, Databricks Genie, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, ThoughtSpot Spotter, Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI where relevant.
* Design AI-ready semantic layers that provide business context, trusted metrics, governed definitions and explainability for conversational BI and agentic analytics use cases.
* Identify appropriate use cases for AI in BI while recognising where traditional dashboards, governed reports or human-led analysis remain more suitable.
* Governance, Adoption & Analytics Operating Model
* Define governance standards for dashboards, semantic models, KPIs, certified datasets, access controls, refresh schedules, lifecycle management and reporting asset ownership.
* Support integration with governance and catalogue platforms such as Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Unity Catalog, Snowflake Horizon, Immuta or equivalent enterprise tools.
* Create templates, design standards, dashboard review checklists, documentation patterns and adoption playbooks for consistent analytics delivery.
* Enable business users through self-service analytics training, guardrails, metric definitions and trusted data consumption practices.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* BI and dashboarding - Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, executive dashboards, self-service reporting, embedded analytics.
* Semantic and analytics engineering - Semantic layers, Fabric Semantic Models, Power BI datasets, metrics layer, governed KPIs, SQL, dbt-style modelling, analytical data products, business glossary alignment.
* Data modelling - Dimensional modelling, star schema design, snowflake schema design, semantic modelling, metric modelling, data mart design, canonical/domain model awareness, data dictionary creation.
* Data analysis and insight generation - Advanced SQL, data profiling, trend analysis, root-cause analysis, variance analysis, segmentation, data storytelling, business analysis, actionable insight generation.
* AI and next-generation analytics - Fabric Copilot, Power BI Copilot, Databricks Genie, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, ThoughtSpot Spotter, Azure OpenAI, conversational BI, semantic search, AI-assisted insights, agentic analytics.
* Governance and operations - Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Unity Catalog, Immuta, certified datasets, data lineage, access controls, dashboard governance, BI adoption, performance optimisation.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Relevant experience guide: 3-7 years
* 3+ years of experience in BI, analytics engineering, data analysis, semantic modelling, data modelling or analytics architecture.
* Strong hands-on experience developing dashboards and semantic models, with the ability to advise on the right BI/self-service analytics tools for business needs.
* Preferred certifications: Power BI Data Analyst, Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer, Tableau, Snowflake/Databricks analytics credentials, AI/GenAI foundations or cloud data certifications.

**Ideally, you'll also have**

* Architect by mindset, not only dashboard developer by nature; able to influence BI strategy and analytics consumption architecture.
* Excellent data analytics, stakeholder management, business consulting and data storytelling skills.
* Understands where AI should and should not be used in analytics workflows, and can guide business users towards trusted, governed and actionable insights.
* Comfortable operating across business, analytics, data engineering, semantic architecture, AI and enterprise governance teams.
* This role is not a traditional BI Developer. It is a Semantic BI Engineer and analytics architect who defines how trusted data is modelled, consumed and converted into actionable insight through governed dashboards, self-service analytics and AI-enabled decision intelligence.

**What We Look For**

* Architect by mindset, not only dashboard developer by nature; able to influence BI strategy and analytics consumption architecture.
* Excellent data analytics, stakeholder management, business consulting and data storytelling skills.
* Understands where AI should and should not be used in analytics workflows, and can guide business users towards trusted, governed and actionable insights.
* Comfortable operating across business, analytics, data engineering, semantic architecture, AI and enterprise governance teams.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we're dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies, and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasises high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that's right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Junior APC Engineer - Process Optimisation Application (PXP)
description:
Join a Culture That Moves Fast — and Brings You With It.
  
  
At Fuller Technologies, momentum isn’t a slogan — it’s how we work. For over 140 years, we’ve improved the systems that keep the cement industry running: optimizing processes, reducing friction, and elevating performance. That mindset shapes not only our solutions — but how we operate as a company.
  
  
When you join Fuller, you’re joining a team that supports your growth and values your contribution. Here, colleagues collaborate openly, leaders give you room to develop, and the environment is built on trust, inclusion, and continuous learning. You’ll find the stability of a global organization and the agility of one that’s actively expanding — a place where your career can accelerate alongside the business.
  
  
If you want to move forward with a company that brings its people with it — Fuller is where that happens.
  
  
**About The Role**
For more than 140 years, Fuller Technologies has helped industrial producers solve complex process challenges and operate more efficiently, reliably, and sustainably. Our success is built on two foundations:
  
  
engineering excellence and long-standing partnerships with our customers.
  
  
As a Junior APC Engineer, you will carry this legacy forward by applying advanced process control, analytics, and AI/ML technologies to cement and mining operations worldwide. At Fuller, APC engineering is not just about control algorithms — it is about understanding the process, earning customer trust, and delivering performance that lasts.
  
  
You will be part of Fullers Process Optimisation Team, working with the ECS/ProcessExpert® APC toolbox and advanced control techniques such as MPC and AI/ML. Your role focuses on delivering APC and soft-sensor solutions that stabilise plant operations, improve throughput, and reduce energy and fuel consumption. This is a hands-on technical role with responsibility across the full APC project lifecycle — from processanalysis and model development to commissioning, optimisation, and long-term performance support.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities:**

* Perform process and data analysis using historical and real-time data from cement and minerals plants to identify optimisation opportunities.
* Design, develop, test, and deploy predictive models and soft sensors using linear and nonlinear AI/ML algorithms. Implement, validate, and maintain real-time APC applications using MPC, AI/ML, fuzzy logic, and PID control strategies.
* Estimate and quantify process improvement benefits using data analytics, supporting performance guarantees and technical proposals.
* Adapt, tune, and retrain models and controllers to ensure sustained performance and operational stability. Define and implement process control strategies, including configuration and commissioning of APC solutions.
* Fine-tune MPC, fuzzy, and PID controllers to achieve guaranteed performance targets related to productivity, energy efficiency, and stability.
* Support system integration activities, including hardware selection, software installation, and connectivity with PLCs, DCS, and historians.
* Collaborate with project managers and customer teams to ensure APC projects are delivered on schedule and to specification.
* Provide training and technical mentoring to customer engineers on data analytics and AI/ML applications within the ECS/ProcessExpert® platform.
* Evaluate emerging developments in advanced analytics and non-linear modelling to continuously improve APC applications.
* Contribute across the broader APC lifecycle, including sales support, product development, feature testing, and service support as required.

**You bring**

* Strong hands-on experience in Advanced Process Control, Data Analytics, Machine Learning, and AI applied to industrial processes.
* Proven experience in data mining, statistical modelling, model deployment, and real-time implementation.
* Background in process manufacturing industries; cement and minerals process knowledge is a strong advantage.
* Solid understanding of process optimisation, control strategy development, and benefit analysis.
* Experience with industrial data connectivity and historians, including SQL, MQTT, PLCs, DCS, and modern data platforms.
* Familiarity with AI/ML and data analytics tools commonly used in process industries, including: Python, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn, TensorFlow, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Databricks
* Willingness to travel (50–70%) within India and internationally for commissioning, pilot testing, customer engagement, and training.

*As an equal opportunity employer, Fuller Technologies embraces diversity and equality by promoting an environment of inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply irrespective of sex, gender identity/expression, disability, sexual orientation, or age. The more diverse our employees are, the stronger our team is.*
**Application and contact**
Please apply by clicking “apply” on this page. Kindly note that we will be reviewing applications and conducting interviews - also on a virtual setting as required - on an ongoing basis so please apply as soon as possible.
  
  
No recruiters and unsolicited agency referrals, please.
  
  
**Build a better world**
Fuller Technologies helps build societies all over the world by contributing to the infrastructure needed for global economic growth. It is a big responsibility, and we are committed to driving growth while minimising environmental impact. To achieve this, your skills, your curiosity, and your drive for change are important. Together in our diverse team, we collaborate in an inclusive and supportive environment to discover further ways to economic and environmental success.
  
  
For further information on Fuller Technologies' business and services, visit https://www.fuller-technologies.com/

Lead architecture reviews, code reviews, design reviews, and operational excellence initiatives

15+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, Distributed Systems, or Enterprise Architecture.
  
  
Proven expertise building and operating large-scale data platforms, real-time systems, and cloud-native applications.

Expertise in data platform modernization, platform engineering, security engineering, and cloud transformation.

title: Princ Engr-AI Science
description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing…**
As a Principal Engineer (Agentic & Applied AI), you will serve as a technical leader and individual performer, architecting and driving end-to-end solutions for complex AI and Agentic use cases across multiple concurrent projects. You will be hands-on in design and coding, while leading project pods with one or two junior engineers or data scientists.
  
  

* Leading the architecture, design, and end-to-end development of complex Agentic AI and traditional AI/ML solutions across multiple concurrent initiatives.
* Working in a collaborative environment with global teams and managing cross-functional stakeholders across business and technical domains to deliver scalable solutions to high-impact business problems.
* Architecting, developing, and deploying LLM-driven applications, multi-agent workflows, autonomous agent systems, and traditional data science models into production environments.
* Translating complex business requirements into robust technical and system architectures, creating high-level and low-level design documents, and articulating architectural decisions and findings to leadership and stakeholders.
* Hands-on coding and system implementation using Python, LangChain, LangGraph, Model Context Protocol (MCP), REST/gRPC APIs, BigQuery, PostgreSQL, and event-driven architectures with Apache Kafka.
* Guiding, mentoring, and technical coaching of junior engineers and data scientists on project pods—conducting peer code and architecture reviews, sharing constructive feedback, and driving the team toward best-in-class technical execution
* Designing and implementing robust testing, validation, evaluation, and observability frameworks (e.g., LLM evals, hallucination mitigation, latency/token optimization, model governance) across the end-to-end AI lifecycle.
* Developing next-generation AI systems with built-in data privacy, ethical AI, bias mitigation, guardrails, and compliance with enterprise security and governance policies.
* Assisting in growing the AI practice by leading POCs, identifying new high-value opportunities, defining architectural blueprints, evaluating emerging tools/frameworks, and contributing to technical white papers and documentation.
* Staying informed on the latest advancements in Generative AI, LLMs, Agentic frameworks, and related tech stacks, finding ways to deliver business value by customizing and applying them to our specific enterprise domain.
* Partnering with ecosystem partners, startups, and open-source communities to explore and integrate cutting-edge AI capabilities.

**What We’re Looking For...**
You have deep technical expertise in modern AI engineering and traditional data science, and you thrive as a hands-on technical lead who bridges architecture, coding, and stakeholder collaboration. You are energized by working in a dynamic environment, handling multiple complex projects simultaneously, and translating ambiguous business problems into reliable, production-ready AI systems. You take pride in technical excellence, enjoy mentoring junior team members, and are passionate about advancing state-of-the-art Agentic and LLM architectures within an enterprise scale.
  
  
**What we're looking for… ("You'll need to have…")**

* Bachelor's degree with six or more years of relevant experience.
* Five or more years of hands-on experience in software engineering, applied machine learning, or advanced data science in production environments.
* One or more years of hands-on experience architecting, building, and deploying Agentic AI and LLM-driven solutions (e.g., autonomous agents, multi-agent systems, tool calling/function calling, agent workflows).
* Strong hands-on proficiency with modern AI orchestration and agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalent agent frameworks.
* Deep familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) architecture, tool integration standards, REST/gRPC APIs, and microservices design.
* Expert-level coding proficiency in Python and solid software engineering practices (OOP, design patterns, modular architecture, CI/CD, testing, code quality).
* Strong experience working with relational, analytical, and streaming data stores: BigQuery, PostgreSQL, and event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka.
* Solid foundation and working understanding of traditional data science methodologies, predictive modeling, machine learning concepts (supervised/unsupervised learning, neural networks, ensembling), and evaluation metrics.
* Experience with all phases of an end-to-end AI project lifecycle: data ingestion/streaming, preprocessing, prompt engineering/fine-tuning, model validation/evals, containerization, deployment, operationalization, monitoring, and tracing.
* Demonstrated track record of leading technical implementation across multiple simultaneous projects and collaborating effectively with cross-functional business and technical stakeholders.
* Experience providing technical mentorship, conducting architectural and code reviews, and giving feedback to junior engineers and data scientists.

**What we're looking for… ("Even better if you have…")**

* Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
* Experience architecting and deploying AI/ML and Agentic solutions in the Telecommunications domain or large-scale enterprise environments.
* Experience with Vector Databases and advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques (hybrid search, reranking, contextual compression).
* Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks and guardrail systems
* Experience with cloud AI platforms (GCP Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure OpenAI) and distributed compute/data infrastructure.
* Experience in optimization, simulation techniques, or operations research applied to enterprise problems.
* Active contributions to open-source AI projects, agent frameworks, or authoring technical white papers and publications.
* Exceptional presentation, communication, and executive storytelling skills with a proven ability to influence technical and non-technical leadership.

Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
  
  
Scheduled Weekly Hours
  
  
40
  
  
Equal Employment Opportunity
  
  
Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: Perception Autonomy Engineer
description:
**Career Area**
Technology, Digital and Data
  
  
**Job Description**
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
Role Definition
  
  
Caterpillar’s Cat Technology team is seeking a Perception Developer to design, develop, and deploy perception software for autonomous and semi-autonomous machines used in construction. The role focuses on multi-sensor perception, computer vision, 3D point-cloud processing, sensor fusion, and production-quality software for safety-critical, resource-constrained platforms. The ideal candidate combines strong C++/Python development skills with hands-on experience building, optimizing, and validating perception algorithms from prototype through field deployment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and implement perception algorithms for object and personnel detection, classification, segmentation, tracking, terrain understanding, localization, mapping, and obstacle assessment.
* Develop camera, LiDAR, radar, GNSS, and IMU processing pipelines, including calibration, synchronization, sensor fusion, and uncertainty handling.
* Translate research concepts and state-of-the-art models into robust, maintainable, production-quality C++ and Python software.
* Optimize algorithms and neural-network inference for embedded CPU/GPU platforms using profiling, CUDA, TensorRT, and related acceleration technologies.
* Build automated evaluation workflows, datasets, simulation scenarios, and test tools to measure accuracy, latency, robustness, and safety performance.
* Debug and resolve perception issues using recorded data, simulation, hardware-in-the-loop systems, and field-machine testing.
* Collaborate with systems, autonomy, controls, embedded software, validation, and safety teams to define interfaces and deliver integrated machine capabilities.
* Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, technical documentation, and continuous improvement of software engineering practices.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.
* Strong programming skills in modern C++ and Python, with experience developing and debugging software on Linux.
* Practical experience with computer vision, deep learning, 3D geometry, point-cloud processing, or robotic perception.
* Experience with one or more perception tasks such as detection, segmentation, classification, tracking, localization, mapping, or sensor fusion.
* Working knowledge of PyTorch or TensorFlow and common perception libraries such as OpenCV, PCL, Eigen, or similar tools.
* Understanding of camera, LiDAR, radar, GNSS, and IMU sensor characteristics, calibration, coordinate systems, and data quality considerations.
* Experience with ROS/ROS 2, DDS, Git, unit testing, continuous integration, and software documentation practices.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills, with the ability to work across research and product-development teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience deploying perception models on embedded or edge platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson, DRIVE, or comparable hardware.
* Experience with CUDA, TensorRT, model quantization, profiling, and real-time performance optimization.
* Knowledge of SLAM, visual or LiDAR odometry, Kalman filtering, probabilistic estimation, and graph-based spatial data structures.
* Experience developing perception systems for autonomous vehicles, ADAS, mobile robots, mining, construction, or off-highway equipment.
* Experience with simulation, synthetic data, dataset curation, annotation workflows, MLOps, or field validation.
* Publications, patents, or demonstrated implementation of state-of-the-art perception methods are an advantage.

Be Part of What’s Next in Autonomous Construction Sites
  
  
Construction autonomy is one of the most complex challenges in applied AI, and at Caterpillar, advancements in physical AI, simulation, sensing, and edge computing are turning things that once felt impossible—intelligent machines operating in dynamic jobsites—into reality.
  
  
Our connected ecosystem brings together massive volumes [BH1.1][LR1.2]of high-quality data to create a foundation where engineers like you can build and deploy against.
  
  
If this work motivates you, we invite you to join our team. In these roles, you’ll work at the intersection of the physical and digital worlds. You’ll help design and deliver intelligent systems that enable machines to perceive their environment, make informed decisions, and support safer, more productive operations.
  
  
Apply today to build the new era of construction autonomy at Caterpillar.
  
  
**Posting Dates**
October 13, 2026 - October 26, 2026
  
  
Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply
  
  
Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community.

title: Specialist, Technology - Software
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
  
  
**Group/Division**
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The LS-SWIFT division delivers high-throughput patterned wafer inspection systems that support advanced semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to provide industry-leading defect detection with optimal cost of ownership across a wide range of applications. LS systems enable precise, cost-effective inspection for cutting-edge process nodes, while SWIFT systems offer comprehensive macro inspection of all wafer surfaces—capabilities that are especially critical for advanced packaging, as well as logic, memory, and automotive applications.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Strong software architecture expertise designing complex, distributed, scalable, high-performance, and data-intensive systems.
* Experience across legacy and modern technology stacks, with the ability to evolve existing platforms and drive architectural improvements.
* Deep technical knowledge in one or more areas: enterprise architecture, cloud-native services, microservices, AI/ML infrastructure, big data platforms, or DevOps automation.
* Proven ability to design and deliver medium-to-large scale software systems in multi-developer, cross-functional environments.
* Strong systems thinking and analytical skills, capable of simplifying ambiguity, evaluating trade-offs, and solving complex technical challenges.
* Expertise in scalability, performance optimization, reliability, and future-proof software design, ensuring robust architectures, code quality, and maintainability.
* Ability to translate complex business and technical requirements into architecture, detailed designs, and executable engineering plans.
* Strong technical leadership and mentoring skills, influencing architects, senior engineers, and technical leads across organizations, geographies, and disciplines.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, effectively engaging both technical and non-technical stakeholders in global teams.
* Ownership-driven mindset with a focus on execution, innovation, and engineering excellence, leveraging modern development practices and AI-assisted engineering tools.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience building and architecting complex distributed systems.
* Familiarity with UI/UX design considerations in engineering applications.

**Technical Skills:**

* Programming: C#, C++, Java, Python, .NET
* Architectural Paradigms: Microservices, service-oriented architecture, modular monolith, layered architecture, event-driven architecture
* Legacy Modernization: Monolith decomposition, migration from thick-client/desktop stacks to modern service-based platforms, backend/frontend separationWorking knowledge of container technologies, orchestration frameworks (e.g., Kubernetes), and workflow automation.Strong grasp of software development best practices, CI/CD, and DevOps principles.
* Leadership & Communication: Demonstrated ability to lead and drive functional teams. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Passion for mentoring and developing engineering talent.

**Minimum Qualifications**
Doctorate (Academic) Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 6 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 8 years
  
  
**About KLA**
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
  
  
**Use of AI Statement**
At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.

*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*
