title: Sr. Solutions Architect - Workday
description:
**Company Overview**
At Zuora, we do Modern Business. We’re helping people subscribe to new ways of doing business that are better for people, companies and ultimately the planet. It’s an approach resulting from the shift to the Subscription Economy that puts customers first by building recurring relationships instead of one-time product sales and focuses on sustainable growth. Through our leading expertise and multi-product suite, we are transforming all industries and working with the world’s most innovative companies to monetize new business models, nurture subscriber relationships and optimize their digital experiences.
  
  
**THE TEAM & ROLE**
Zuora’s Corporate Operations organization serves as the backbone of our internal technology ecosystem, building digital experiences that connect teams, align business priorities, and strengthen collaboration company-wide. Taking a cloud-first, AI-enabled approach, we empower our global ZEOs with modern tools and self-service solutions that drive productivity, scalability, and agility - all while upholding the highest standards of security and compliance.
  
  
Within Corporate Operations, the G&A Business Applications team designs, implements, and optimizes the systems that power all of Zuora's core General & Administrative functions, including Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success (HR), and Legal. Reporting to the Senior Business Systems Manager of Digital Workplace Experience, this team works closely with system analysts, administrators, project managers, data architects, and developers to deliver robust, scalable business solutions.
  
  
The Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems is a senior technical expert and data architect responsible for designing, building, and securing enterprise-grade data structures and integrations across our corporate systems ecosystem. This role functions as a critical cross-functional data and system integration specialist, ensuring seamless data flow, robust security governance, and scalable automation across diverse business platforms (e.g., Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, and more).
  
  
You’ll join a collaborative, high-performing team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and professional growth. Your work will directly impact the efficiency, quality, and scalability of Zuora’s enterprise systems and digital transformation initiatives.
  
  
**YOUR MISSION**
As a senior technical anchor supporting all G&A functions, the Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems collaborates closely with leaders across Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal to establish a cohesive enterprise data architecture. You will build robust system integrations and leverage cutting-edge AI frameworks to drive efficiency, maximize data reliability, and enforce strict compliance across all internal platforms in alignment with strategic goals.
  
  
**YOUR OPPORTUNITY**
As the Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems, you will play a vital role in the development, data architecture, and integration of Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal systems. Combining your expertise as a data architect and multi-platform integration specialist, you’ll ensure seamless data flow, scalable automation, and cross-system reliability without being tied to a single core vendor. You’ll work closely with functional BSAs to prioritize initiatives, refine user stories, and deliver enhancements through agile sprints, while supporting testing and deployment activities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Lead integration support and comprehensive data architecture across core Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal business systems, ensuring cross-platform data consistency and process efficiency.
* Define and maintain end-to-end data models, data lineage, and integration patterns across all G&A applications, establishing a unified "single source of truth" bridging corporate finance, workforce analytics, and legal operations.
* Design, build, and optimize secure, high-performing API-based integrations, microservices, and file-based data flows (REST API, Webhooks, OAuth 2.0, SQL) across Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, and more tools.
* Architect and implement AI-driven automation workflows; evaluate and integrate AI productivity tools and emerging standard frameworks—such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers—to safely expose internal tools and secure data layers to AI agents.
* Enforce strict data security policies, field-level encryption, masking, and access controls across integrated systems to protect sensitive workforce metrics (ZEO Success/PII), legal records, and financial data.
* Collaborate with cross-functional BSAs, business cross functional teams, and security teams using RACI frameworks to clearly map out data ownership, system accountability, and technical execution roles across different departments.
* Ensure configuration standards, technical architecture diagrams, and SOPs are up to date and fully compliant with internal controls, SOX, and global privacy standards (GDPR/CCPA).

**OUR TECH STACK:**
REST API, Webhooks, OAuth 2.0, SQL, JavaScript/Python, Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, AI Automation Tools, and MCP Server frameworks.
  
  
**What You’ll Accomplish**

* Deliver Modern Data Architecture: Transition fragmented cross-system data points from disparate G&A tools into a beautifully mapped out, resilient, and highly secure enterprise data model.
* Excellence in System Integrations: Establish scalable, automated data connections that allow Finance, FP&A, Procurement, HR, and Legal tools to communicate without operational friction, keeping sync latencies low and reliability high.
* Next-Gen Tech Adoption: Successfully implement secure AI extensions or MCP servers to optimize everyday business workflows and scale manual reporting processes down to self-service models.
* Advance Automation & Data Reliability: Develop solutions that strengthen data accuracy, eliminate manual tasks, reduce operational overhead, and increase system reliability across end-to-end business workflows.
* Promote Secure & Compliant Operations: Collaborate with IT, Security, and Audit teams to uphold field-level data protection, access controls, and strict compliance (SOX/GDPR) across all integration data layers.
* Establish Sustainable System Practices: Maintain clear documentation, SOPs, and configuration standards to ensure long-term scalability and consistent cross-functional operational excellence.

**What You’ll Need To Be Successful**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Architecture, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 8+ years of experience in system integrations and backend development (Proficient in REST APIs, SQL, JavaScript/Python, OAuth, and web services).
* Deep hands-on exposure to data structures and integration patterns within modern G&A systems—specifically covering tools across Procurement (Coupa), HR/ATS (Workday, Lattice, Greenhouse), and ERP/Expense (NetSuite, Navan).
* Proven understanding of LLM application patterns, AI integration tools, and modular protocol concepts like Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Solid understanding of data security standards, encryption practices, access control models, and IT/SOX compliance frameworks required when handling sensitive employee, financial, and legal records.
* Strong familiarity with project governance frameworks, including using RACI matrices to clarify cross-team responsibilities.
* Exceptional cross-functional collaboration and communication skills; the ability to elegantly translate complex technical and data architecture blueprints to functional business partners across completely different business disciplines.

**#ZEOLife at Zuora**
As an industry pioneer, our work is constantly evolving and challenging us in new ways that require us to think differently, iterate often and learn constantly—it’s exciting. Our people, whom we refer to as “ZEOs" are empowered to take on a mindset of ownership and make a bigger impact here. Our teams collaborate deeply, exchange different ideas openly and together we’re making what’s next possible for our customers, community and the world.
  
  
As Part Of Our Commitment To Building An Inclusive, High-performance Culture Where ZEOs Feel Inspired, Connected And Valued, We Support ZEOs With
  
  
Competitive compensation, corporate bonus program and performance rewards, company equity and retirement programs
  
  
Medical, dental and vision insurance
  
  
Generous, flexible time off
  
  
Paid holidays, “wellness” days and company wide end of year break
  
  
Learning & Development stipend
  
  
Opportunities to volunteer and give back, including charitable donation match
  
  
Free resources and support for your mental wellbeing
  
  

* Specific benefits offerings may vary by country and can be viewed in more detail during your interview process.

Location & Work Arrangements
  
  
Organizations and teams at Zuora are empowered to design efficient and flexible ways of working, being intentional about scheduling, communication, and collaboration strategies that help us achieve our best results. In our dynamic, globally distributed company, this means balancing flexibility and responsibility — flexibility to live our lives to the fullest, and responsibility to each other, to our customers, and to our shareholders. For most roles, we offer the flexibility to work both remotely and at Zuora offices.
  
  
Our Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace
  
  
Think, be and do you! At Zuora, different perspectives, experiences and contributions matter. Everyone counts. Zuora is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all.
  
  
Zuora does not discriminate on the basis of, and considers individuals seeking employment with Zuora without regards to, race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
  
  
We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us by sending an email to assistance@zuora.com.

title: Analyst, Algorithm Research & Development
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
  
  
**Group/Division**
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The Measurement, Analytics and Control (MACH) division is KLA’s software powerhouse, responsible for developing high-performance software platforms that support semiconductor manufacturing. MACH delivers cutting-edge technologies in patterning analytics, modeling, and data science—empowering chipmakers to ramp next-gen devices faster and more efficiently. Our cross-functional team of research scientists, software engineers, apps engineers and process engineers are solving the industry’s most complex technical problems.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an intellectually curious and technically exceptional AI Engineer to join our Applied AI Research organization.
  
  
This role is designed for individuals who enjoy moving beyond application of established techniques and are motivated by solving problems that have no obvious solution. The successful candidate will combine strong software engineering fundamentals with expertise in machine learning, statistical algorithms, deep learning, and agentic AI systems to create next-generation intelligence platforms for semiconductor manufacturing and engineering.
  
  
Unlike traditional software engineering roles, this position requires a strong research mindset. We are looking for engineers who question assumptions, derive first-principles understanding of problems, conduct systematic experimentation, and translate emerging research into practical business impact.
  
  
This role offers a unique opportunity to grow into a future technical and research leader capable of influencing the direction of AI, analytics, and intelligent automation across the organization.
  
  
**Vision for the Role**
Over the next several years, this individual is expected to evolve from an AI engineer into a recognized research leader who:
  
  

* Shapes the organization's AI strategy through technical innovation.
* Drives a culture of experimentation and evidence-based decision making.
* Bridges cutting-edge AI research with real-world engineering applications.
* Identifies transformational technologies before they become mainstream.
* Inspires teams to pursue ambitious technical challenges.
* Builds an innovation ecosystem through mentorship, technical leadership, and collaboration.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Applied AI Research**

* Investigate emerging AI techniques and evaluate their applicability to semiconductor manufacturing and engineering workflows.
* Conduct hands-on research in areas such as:

+ Foundation Models
+ Agentic AI Systems
+ Scientific Machine Learning
+ Computer Vision
+ Reinforcement Learning
+ Probabilistic Modeling
+ Knowledge Representation
+ Multi-Agent Systems
+ Causal AI

* Develop novel approaches for solving difficult engineering and manufacturing problems.
* Design rigorous experimental frameworks to validate hypotheses and quantify impact.
* Translate research findings into scalable product capabilities.

**Statistical Learning & Algorithm Development**
Design and develop advanced algorithms utilizing:
  
  

* Bayesian Inference
* Probabilistic Graphical Models
* Design of Experiments (DOE)
* Time-Series Analysis
* Optimization Techniques
* Causal Inference
* Anomaly Detection
* Predictive Modeling
* Multivariate Statistics
* Graph Analytics

Responsibilities include:
  
  

* Creating explainable and scientifically sound models.
* Evaluating statistical significance of experimental outcomes.
* Building decision-support and autonomous reasoning systems.

**Deep Learning & Scientific AI**
Develop next-generation deep learning solutions for:
  
  

* Defect Management
* Yield Analytics
* Manufacturing Optimization
* Image Understanding
* Pattern Recognition
* Engineering Knowledge Discovery

Work with and innovate on:
  
  

* CNNs
* Vision Transformers
* Multimodal Models
* Graph Neural Networks
* Self-Supervised Learning
* Representation Learning
* Foundation Models
* Diffusion Architectures

Candidates should be comfortable reading research papers, reproducing published techniques, and identifying opportunities for improvement.
  
  
**Agentic AI & Intelligent Systems**
Develop intelligent autonomous systems capable of:
  
  

* Planning
* Reasoning
* Tool Usage
* Workflow Orchestration
* Long-Horizon Goal Achievement

Build sophisticated AI systems using:
  
  

* LangGraph
* Semantic Kernel
* AutoGen
* CrewAI
* OpenAI Agent Frameworks
* MCP (Model Context Protocol)

Examples include:
  
  

* AI Copilots
* Manufacturing Assistants
* Engineering Intelligence Platforms
* Autonomous Analytics Systems
* Knowledge Agents

**Software Engineering Excellence**
Develop production-grade solutions using:
  
  
**Primary Languages**

* Python
* Modern C++ (C++17/20)

**Additional Technologies**

* PyTorch
* Ray
* Spark
* Kubernetes
* Docker
* Vector Databases
* Graph Databases

The candidate should be able to transform research prototypes into scalable and maintainable products.
  
  
**Research Leadership Expectations**
Although this is an individual contributor role, the candidate is expected to actively contribute to building a research culture.
  
  
This includes:
  
  

* Leading technical reading groups.
* Reviewing and discussing recent research papers.
* Driving internal innovation initiatives.
* Mentoring junior engineers on research methodology.
* Promoting first-principles thinking.
* Encouraging experimentation and hypothesis-driven development.
* Establishing engineering rigor around benchmarking and evaluation.

Success is measured not only by feature delivery but also by the advancement of the team's collective technical capability.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
**Education**
MS or PhD preferred in:
  
  

* Computer Science
* Machine Learning
* Artificial Intelligence
* Statistics
* Applied Mathematics
* Electrical Engineering
* Related STEM discipline

**Experience**
Typically:
  
  

* BS + 5 years
* OR MS + 3 years
* OR PhD

Demonstrated experience in building production AI systems while maintaining strong interest in research and innovation.
  
  
**Ideal Candidate Profile**
The ideal candidate is someone who:
  
  

* Reads research papers for fun.
* Questions conventional assumptions.
* Enjoys tackling open-ended technical challenges.
* Can move seamlessly from theory to implementation.
* Has strong mathematical intuition.
* Is passionate about creating new knowledge, not merely applying existing solutions.
* Wants to become a future Principal Engineer, Distinguished Engineer, or AI Research Leader.

**What Success Looks Like After 3-5 Years**
This engineer will have:
  
  

* Become a recognized technical authority in AI and analytics.
* Influenced the AI roadmap for multiple products.
* Originated innovations that materially impact product differentiation.
* Built a thriving culture of experimentation and technical excellence.
* Mentored the next generation of AI engineers and researchers.
* Established KLA as a leader in AI-native semiconductor manufacturing intelligence.

**Minimum Qualifications**
Doctorate (Academic) Degree and 0 years related work experience; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 5 years
  
  
**About KLA**
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
  
  
**Use of AI Statement**
At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.
  
  
*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*
*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*

  **Equity Market Technology -Capital Markets domain.**

  .

* The candidate will
  **provide technical leadership to a team of AI engineers**
  , collaborate closely with stakeholders, data scientists, and platform teams, and translate business requirements into robust, secure, and scalable AI solutions.

* The role requires strong hands-on
  **technical expertise, solution architecture capabilities, and the ability to lead AI initiatives from Concept to Production.**

**Details of Employment:**

**Location:**
Chennai, India

**Work Location**
– Guindy Olympia Tech Park OR SIPCOT Siruseri.

**Mode of Employment**
- 3 days Hybrid in the Office.

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time, Permanent.

**Notice Period**
- 0 to 15 days from the date of the offer (
**Critical Requisition; hence the ask**
)

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. AI Architecture and Solution Design**

* Architect and lead the development of enterprise-grade RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, vector databases, embedding models, and retrieval strategies using Azure AI Search, FAISS, and Pinecone.
* Design and implement Agentic AI systems incorporating autonomous agents, multi-step planning, tool orchestration, reasoning workflows, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Develop AI solutions that integrate with internal systems, including trading platforms, operations workbenches, and risk engines, to automate decision support, exception handling, and reporting.
* Establish standards for prompt engineering, AI guardrails, and evaluation frameworks, including offline evaluations, A/B testing, and automated regression testing.

**2. Azure Cloud and AI Platform Engineering**

* Lead the design, implementation, and management of AI/ML infrastructure on Microsoft Azure using Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Functions, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
* Design scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient AI inference pipelines using caching, request batching, and token-budget optimization.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines for ML models and AI agents, incorporating model versioning, controlled deployments, A/B testing, rollback mechanisms, and observability.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise cloud governance, data residency, and security requirements using Azure Private Endpoints, Managed Identity, Key Vault, and related security controls.

**3. AI Performance Optimization and Troubleshooting**

* Diagnose and resolve production AI performance issues, including inference latency, embedding drift, retrieval quality degradation, hallucinations, and context-window limitations.
* Monitor and optimize token consumption, API rate limits, throughput, and cost per query across production AI workloads.
* Establish AI observability through structured logging, distributed tracing across prompt processing, retrieval, and generation, and dashboards tracking latency (p50/p95/p99), retrieval recall, and answer relevance.
* Conduct root-cause analysis of AI system failures, including incorrect tool invocations, RAG retrieval failures, safety-filter false positives, and model regressions following version upgrades.

**4. Technical Leadership and Collaboration**

* Lead and mentor a team of 4–6 AI/ML engineers, overseeing code reviews, architecture decisions, sprint planning, engineering standards, and professional development.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, data scientists, quantitative teams, and operations leaders to translate business requirements into scalable, production-ready AI solutions.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies, model releases, fine-tuning techniques, agent frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, and CrewAI, and AI evaluation methodologies.
* Represent the AI engineering function in technical design reviews, architecture governance forums, and incident post-mortems.
* Drive engineering best practices and continuous improvement across AI solution design, development, deployment, monitoring, security, and operational support.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
As a Software Engineering Manager within MS TECH Order Fulfillment, you will provide strategic product and technical leadership, along with hands-on expertise, to build industry-leading products. You are a systems thinker capable of driving large-scale transformations that maximize value for Ford, our Dealers, and our customers. The role combines high-level strategy, including product vision, AI/ML use-case portfolio, data strategy, and technical roadmaps, with disciplined execution to deliver scalable, resilient, secure, explainable, and highly available solutions in a global environment.
  
  
**Technical Leadership & Vision**

* Serve as the primary technical authority for the Order Generation product suite, defining the evolution of the technology stack, data architecture, AI/ML capabilities, and architectural patterns.
* Lead cross-functional teams through complex integrations, managing dependencies across the broader Order Fulfillment ecosystem to ensure seamless data flow and system interoperability.
* Translate high-level business requirements into actionable technical strategies that align with Ford enterprise standards.

**AI/ML Product Strategy & Innovation**

* Define and execute an AI/ML and data analytics product strategy that converts priority business requirements into a sequenced portfolio of intelligent capabilities and measurable outcomes.
* Identify, evaluate, and prioritize AI/ML opportunities across forecasting, order generation, decision support, anomaly detection, optimization, and workflow automation using value, feasibility, risk, data readiness, and adoption criteria.
* Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of AI/ML products from discovery, business-case development, experimentation, and MVP validation through industrialization, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with Data Science, Data Engineering, Product, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Legal, Privacy, and business teams to ensure solutions are technically sound, usable, compliant, and aligned with responsible AI principles.
* Establish outcome-based product metrics, experimentation methods, model performance targets, and adoption measures; use evidence and customer feedback to guide investment and roadmap decisions.
* Monitor emerging technologies, including generative AI, agentic AI, foundation models, advanced analytics, optimization, and intelligent automation, and determine where they can create differentiated business value.
* Drive build, buy, or partner assessments and develop scalable patterns for reusable AI/ML services, data products, model APIs, and decision intelligence capabilities.

**Product Strategy & Delivery**

* Partner with business stakeholders to define and execute a multi-year product vision and roadmap focused on optimized order forecasting and generation.
* Champion an iterative, Agile delivery model, prioritizing the delivery of Minimum Viable Products (MVPs) and maintaining a high-velocity release cadence.
* Apply Human-Centered Design (HCD) principles to ensure technical solutions solve real-world problems for Dealers and customers.
* Create launch and adoption plans that include operational readiness, user training, change management, benefit tracking, and feedback loops.

**Data, Model & MLOps Excellence**

* Ensure AI/ML solutions are supported by trusted, governed, discoverable, and fit-for-purpose data, with clear ownership, lineage, quality controls, and access patterns.
* Guide the implementation of robust MLOps and LLMOps practices covering reproducible experimentation, model registry, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, retraining, rollback, and auditability.
* Define controls for model quality, explainability, bias and fairness evaluation, privacy, security, human oversight, and responsible use throughout the product lifecycle.
* Balance predictive accuracy with interpretability, latency, cost, reliability, and business usability when selecting models and architectures.

**Engineering & Operational Excellence**

* Enforce rigorous engineering standards, including Test-Driven Development (TDD), robust CI/CD pipelines, and DevSecOps practices.
* Drive a culture of Full Lifecycle Ownership, where the team is responsible for the design, security, deployment, and operational health of its services.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for system health, code quality, delivery velocity, model performance, data quality, adoption, and realized business value.

**Architectural Design**

* Architect and oversee the development of cloud-native, microservices-based systems designed for global scale, multi-tenancy, and high-performance transactional processing.
* Design interoperable data and AI architectures that support batch and real-time inference, event-driven workflows, APIs, observability, and secure integration with enterprise platforms.

**People Leadership & Talent Development**

* Cultivate a high-performing, diverse team of Software Engineers, Product Managers, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and ML Engineers through active coaching, mentorship, and career pathing.
* Foster a culture of psychological safety and continuous learning, utilizing blameless retrospectives and regular feedback loops to drive team growth.
* Identify and close skill gaps within the team to keep pace with emerging technologies and industry trends.

**Strategic Collaboration**

* Act as a bridge between the product team and domain experts in Cloud Infrastructure, Data & AI, Cybersecurity, Responsible AI, SRE, and DevOps to reduce portfolio complexity.
* Influence stakeholders across the organization to adopt modern engineering practices, responsible AI controls, reusable data products, and standardized service contracts.

**Technical Execution (Hands-on)**

* Maintain deep technical fluency in the team’s primary languages, frameworks, cloud services, data platforms, and AI/ML toolchain, including Java, Spring Boot, GCP/Azure, Vertex AI, and modern MLOps platforms.
* Lead from the front by participating in architecture and code reviews, resolving complex technical blockers, reviewing model and data design decisions, and occasionally prototyping high-risk or emerging technology concepts.
* Experience: 10+ years of progressive software engineering, digital product, data, or AI/ML solution delivery experience, with a significant portion in engineering and product leadership roles.
* AI/ML Product Leadership: Demonstrated experience strategizing, developing, launching, and scaling AI/ML-based products that address business requirements and deliver measurable operational or customer outcomes.
* Product Strategy: Experience defining product vision, business cases, roadmaps, prioritization frameworks, MVPs, go-to-market or launch plans, adoption strategies, and value-realization metrics for data and AI products.
* Education: Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related quantitative field.
* Certifications: Industry certifications relevant to software engineering, cloud, data, or AI/ML, or a commitment to obtain them within 6 months. GCP Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Machine Learning Engineer, or equivalent certification is a plus.
* Cloud Expertise: 4+ years of experience delivering production solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including cloud-native application and data/AI services.
* Technical Depth: Expertise in microservices, cloud-native architectures, event-driven architectures, APIs, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), distributed systems, and secure enterprise integration.
* AI/ML & Analytics: Strong working knowledge of supervised and unsupervised learning, time-series forecasting, optimization, anomaly detection, feature engineering, model evaluation, experimentation, and production inference patterns.
* Data Engineering: Experience with data architectures, data pipelines, data quality, governance, metadata and lineage, feature stores, batch and streaming data, and analytics platforms.
* MLOps / LLMOps: Hands-on experience establishing or governing CI/CD/CT for models, experiment tracking, model registry, automated validation, deployment, observability, drift monitoring, retraining, and lifecycle controls.
* Responsible AI: Experience applying secure and responsible AI practices, including privacy, transparency, explainability, bias and fairness assessment, human oversight, access controls, risk management, and auditability.
* Technology Stack: Hands-on experience with Java, Angular, Python, SQL, Terraform, Postgres, APIGEE, Kubernetes, Docker, serverless technologies, and containerization. Experience with Vertex AI, BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, or equivalent cloud services is strongly preferred.
* Engineering Excellence: Thorough knowledge of multi-threading, concurrency, parallel processing, DevSecOps, test automation, and monitoring tools such as Dynatrace or Google Cloud Monitoring.
* Developer Experience: Experience increasing developer productivity by integrating AI agents, coding assistants, reusable platform capabilities, or AI skills into the development lifecycle.
* Leadership Qualities: Proven ability to lead large-scale transformations, apply systems thinking, create psychologically safe teams, influence complex decisions, and earn the respect of strong individual technical talent through competence and mentorship.
* Communication & Business Acumen: Ability to communicate complex technical and AI concepts to executives and business partners, align diverse stakeholders, manage trade-offs, and connect product investments to business outcomes.

**Nice to Have**

* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related field.
* Experience with Vertex AI, BigQuery, Feature Store, Gemini or other foundation-model platforms, vector search, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows, and evaluation frameworks.
* Experience building reusable enterprise platforms and underlying services for data, analytics, and AI capabilities.
* Experience with forecasting, supply chain, order fulfillment, demand planning, optimization, or decision intelligence products.
* Ability to translate product roadmaps into manageable features through quarterly scoping sessions and assist product teams directly with technical blockers.
* Proven ability to identify and mitigate delivery, data, model, security, adoption, and operational risks while assessing overall product health and prompting timely decisions.
* Strong understanding of business priorities and technical feasibility to prioritize platform backlogs and manage dependencies.
* Experience with Lean methodology, eXtreme Programming (XP), Agile product management, and Human-Centered Design.
* Experience championing modern software, data, AI/ML, product, and responsible AI practices within a large organization.

title: AI Architect
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced AI Architect to lead the agentic AI engineering function, taking ownership of the design, architecture, and quality of AI agents across the platform.

The role involves defining engineering standards for prompt design, agent evaluation, and Large Language Model (LLM) integration. The ideal candidate will combine deep technical expertise in AI/ML engineering with strong architectural leadership, ensuring AI agents are reliable, scalable, accurate, and cost-effective in production.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and establish the agent engineering framework, including orchestration patterns, prompt governance, and tool-calling standards.
* Lead design reviews for AI agent implementations across the engineering team.
* Own the Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline architecture, including embedding strategies, retrieval optimisation, and accuracy benchmarks.
* Define and implement agent evaluation frameworks covering golden datasets, confidence calibration, and regression testing.
* Establish prompt engineering standards and lead the prompt review board.
* Mentor junior-level (JL1) engineers in agent development, testing, and evaluation.

title: Manager Engineering
description:
**Career Area**

**Job Description**
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
Role Definition
  
  
The Engineering Manager – Data Science is responsible for leading, coaching, and developing multiple pods of data scientists and machine learning engineers while ensuring high-quality, timely delivery of data science products and platforms. This role partners closely with AI product owners, AI architects, platform teams, and business stakeholders to ensure data science solutions are technically sound, scalable, and aligned to strategic outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
People Leadership & Talent Development
  
  

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of data scientists and ML engineers
* Set clear performance expectations and support career development
* Foster an inclusive, high-performing team culture

Technical & Engineering Leadership
  
  

* Provide technical guidance across data science and ML solutions working closely with AI Architects
* Ensure adherence to engineering standards and MLOps practices
* Review model designs and deployment strategies

Delivery & Execution Management
  
  

* Own delivery execution and capacity planning
* Ensure predictable, high-quality delivery
* Manage risks, dependencies, and technical debt

Stakeholder Collaboration
  
  

* Partner with AI Product Owners and business stakeholders
* Communicate progress, risks, and outcomes clearly

Quality, Governance & Responsible AI
  
  

* Ensure solutions meet quality, security, and compliance standards
* Uphold responsible AI principles

Degree Requirement
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, data science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Post Graduate or higher is desired.
  
  
Skill Descriptors
  
  
**Engineering Management**
Demonstrated ability to lead and develop high‑performing technical teams delivering complex data science and machine learning solutions. Provides clear direction, sets expectations, and holds teams accountable for outcomes while supporting individual growth and engagement. Balances people leadership, technical oversight, and delivery execution in a fast‑moving environment.
  
  
**Data Science & Machine Learning**
Strong working knowledge of data science, machine learning, GenAI and statistical modeling concepts, including supervised and unsupervised learning, feature engineering, model evaluation, and experimentation. Able to guide and review technical approaches, challenge assumptions, and ensure solutions are fit for purpose without requiring hands‑on model development as a primary responsibility.
  
  
**Delivery & Execution**
Proven ability to plan, prioritize, and execute work in Agile or hybrid delivery environments. Manages team capacity, dependencies, and risks to ensure predictable delivery of high‑quality outcomes. Uses data and metrics to assess progress, identify issues early, and drive continuous improvement.
  
  
**Communication & Collaboration**
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts to non‑technical audiences. Builds strong partnerships with product owners, architects, platform teams, and business stakeholders to align expectations, manage trade‑offs, and deliver value.
  
  
Software Development Life Cycle
  
  
Demonstrated knowledge of software and data science development life cycles, including experimentation, prototyping, production deployment, and ongoing operations. Understands the differences between research‑oriented work and production‑grade solutions and guides teams accordingly.
  
  

* Works within formal delivery and governance methodologies
* Understands phases, activities, dependencies, and key decision points across the life cycle
* Identifies common risks and quality considerations at each stage
* Interprets and guides technical documentation, design artifacts, and delivery plans

Artificial Intelligence
  
  
Working knowledge of artificial intelligence, GenAI and machine learning concepts, risks, and opportunities, with the ability to guide teams toward solutions that deliver business outcomes responsibly.
  
  

* Understands AI methodologies, capabilities, and limitations
* Guides teams in applying responsible AI principles, including fairness, transparency, robustness, and governance
* Keeps informed of emerging AI technologies and evaluates their applicability to business needs
* Supports the adoption of AI practices that balance innovation with risk management

Programming & Technical Literacy
  
  
Strong technical literacy across programming and data science tools sufficient to effectively review code, designs, and technical approaches.
  
  

* Able to assess code quality, maintainability, and architectural alignment
* Collaborates effectively with hands‑on engineers and data scientists
* Understands testing, version control, and deployment concepts
* Hands‑on coding is not a primary responsibility, but technical depth is sufficient to guide and challenge solutions

Technical Troubleshooting
  
  
Demonstrated ability to lead teams through complex technical and operational issues across data, models, and production systems.
  
  

* Guides investigation and resolution of data, model, and system issues
* Reviews logs, metrics, and system behavior to support root cause analysis
* Partners with platform and operations teams to resolve production incidents
* Ensures issues are documented, learnings are captured, and preventative actions are implemented

Note
  
  
This Job Description is intended as a general guide to the job duties for this position and is intended for the purpose of establishing the specific salary grade. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as an exhaustive summary of all responsibilities, duties, and effort required of employees assigned to this job. title: Associate Senior Solutions Architect - req38675
description:
**Associate Senior Solutions Architect**

Organization: World Bank

Closing Date: 10/30/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC
  
  
**Description**
At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd
  
  
**ITS Vice Presidency Context**
The Information and Technology Solutions (ITS) Vice Presidential Unit (VPU) enables the World Bank Group to achieve its mission of ending extreme poverty and boost shared prosperity on a livable planet by delivering transformative information and technologies to its staff working in over 150+ locations. For more information on ITS, see this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?reload=9&v=VTFGffa1Y7w
  
  
**Department Context**
The ITS Operations Products unit (ITSOP) enables the Bank's operational business processes through modern, flexible and user-friendly digital products. Its portfolio includes Operations Workspace and related solutions that bring together operational data, documents, workflows, collaboration and decision support for front-line staff.
  
  
ITSOP is seeking an Associate Senior Solutions Architect to provide hands-on architecture and engineering leadership for the Operations Workspace ecosystem. The successful candidate will combine deep Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Dataverse expertise with strong .NET and Azure engineering skills, personally implement prototypes and reference solutions, and guide delivery teams from design through production. The role will also help integrate Generative AI and agentic capabilities into operational workflows using a governed AI Development Lifecycle (ADLC). This is not a purely advisory role.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
The Associate Senior Solutions Architect translates complex operational requirements into secure, scalable and maintainable solutions across Dynamics 365, Dataverse, .NET, Azure, APIs, data platforms and AI services. The role defines architecture, validates choices through working code, establishes reusable patterns and guardrails, and remains directly engaged in troubleshooting, CI/CD, release readiness and production improvement.
  
  
**Duties And Accountabilities**
The Associate Senior Solutions Architect works across multiple projects in the World Bank Operations portfolio and is accountable for ensuring that technical solutions are successfully designed, delivered and operated for Operations staff.
  
  
From a work-program perspective, the role provides technical leadership, delivery oversight and practical guidance to internal staff and globally distributed vendor teams. The architect helps sequence technical work, resolves delivery constraints and ensures that implementation remains aligned with business priorities, enterprise standards and release commitments.
  
  
From a technical perspective, the role leads application, integration and data architecture; identifies solution components and reusable patterns; validates designs through working prototypes; performs quality and code reviews; and remains accountable for delivery at speed, scale and quality.
  
  
**Role Scope and Distinction**

* Acts as a senior technical subject matter expert for complex, business-critical solutions in the Operations Workspace portfolio.
* Balances strategic architecture with recent, demonstrable hands-on contribution to prototypes, code, integration, deployment and technical problem-solving.
* Leads cross-layer design decisions involving applications, workflows, data, APIs, identity, security, observability and AI-enabled experiences.
* Guides multidisciplinary teams and vendors, mentors architects and engineers, and raises engineering quality through practical standards and reusable implementation assets.
* Works across globally distributed business, product, architecture, security, data, platform and engineering stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Architecture and Technical Leadership**

* Lead end-to-end solution architecture for Operations Workspace and related products, aligning business outcomes, enterprise principles, security requirements and delivery constraints.
* Define target-state and transition architectures, solution options, architecture decision records, integration contracts, non-functional requirements and implementation roadmaps.
* Review designs and code for scalability, resilience, maintainability, interoperability, usability, performance and cost effectiveness.
* Identify systemic risks and technical debt, propose pragmatic remediation, and guide Agile Release Train and product teams through implementation trade-offs.

Lead solution delivery teams through implementation, maintenance, release readiness and operational improvement of business-critical applications supporting Operations Workspace and related Operations product ecosystems.
  
  
Lead application and data architecture modelling, component identification and solution quality reviews, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture principles and approved technology standards.
  
  
**Dynamics 365 and Dataverse Engineering**

* Architect and implement Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Dataverse solutions, including data models, security roles, business rules, workflows, plug-ins, custom actions, Power Platform components and environment strategy.
* Design supported extension patterns using C#/.NET, the Dataverse SDK and APIs while minimizing fragile customization and preserving upgradeability.
* Guide integration of Dynamics 365 with SharePoint Online, Microsoft Graph, Azure services, enterprise data products and other operational systems.
* Define application lifecycle management practices for solutions, configuration, environment variables, connection references, test data and controlled promotion across environments.

**Hands-on Prototyping and .NET Engineering**

* Personally design, code, test and demonstrate proofs of concept, technical spikes, reference implementations and minimum viable solutions.
* Develop secure APIs, services, plug-ins and integration components using C#, modern .NET, ASP.NET Core and RESTful patterns.
* Validate architecture choices through executable prototypes, performance tests and failure-mode testing before major delivery investment.
* Troubleshoot complex issues across user experience, application, integration, identity, data and infrastructure layers, and support teams during critical releases.

**Integration, Cloud and Platform Architecture**

* Design API-led, event-driven and workflow-based integrations using appropriate Azure services, API management, messaging, serverless and container patterns.
* Apply identity-first design using Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, least privilege, secrets management and auditable authorization patterns, including B2E and approved external-access scenarios.
* Define observability using structured logging, distributed tracing, metrics, dashboards and actionable alerts across application and integration components.
* Collaborate with data and platform teams to connect operational applications to governed data services, analytics products and structured and unstructured enterprise information.

Design integrations with institutional systems and data platforms, including financing, trust funds, board operations, budgeting, SAP and enterprise data services, using supported APIs, events and workflow patterns.
  
  
Architect document and content-management integrations across Dynamics 365, SharePoint Online and approved cloud services, including secure storage, metadata, retrieval and downstream AI processing.
  
  
**Agentic AI and AI-enabled Operations**

* Design and prototype AI-enabled features and agentic workflows embedded in Operations Workspace, with explicit task boundaries, approved tools, controlled permissions, human review and failure handling.
* Integrate agents with Dynamics 365, enterprise APIs, documents, data platforms and business workflows using secure tool calling, structured outputs and reusable orchestration patterns.
* Apply retrieval-augmented generation, document intelligence and knowledge-grounding approaches where they improve operational workflows and decision support.
* Define evaluation, telemetry and guardrails for groundedness, task success, safety, latency, reliability and cost, and ensure Responsible AI, privacy, records and security requirements are addressed.

Partner with information security teams on architecture reviews, threat modelling, control implementation, security testing and remediation evidence required for production approval.
  
  
**Delivery Lifecycle, CI/CD and Engineering Excellence**

* Establish and improve CI/CD pipelines for Dynamics 365 solutions, .NET services, infrastructure configuration and AI components using Azure DevOps or equivalent enterprise tooling.
* Embed automated unit, integration, contract, security, regression and performance testing into delivery pipelines, with quality gates, approvals, release evidence and rollback approaches.
* Apply both the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and a governed AI Development Lifecycle (ADLC), covering use-case framing, data and grounding readiness, prompt and tool versioning, evaluation, deployment, monitoring and change control.
* Create reusable templates, starter repositories, SDKs, reference pipelines, coding standards and implementation guidance that improve developer productivity and consistency.

**Stakeholder, Vendor and Team Leadership**

* Translate operational needs into feasible technical choices and communicate architecture decisions and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Provide practical technical direction to internal teams and vendors, review deliverables against agreed architecture and quality expectations, and intervene hands-on where necessary.
* Mentor architects and engineers through pairing, design reviews, code reviews, demonstrations and knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Partner with product leadership to sequence enablers, reduce delivery risk and ensure technical work results in measurable operational value.

Provide work-program oversight for internal and vendor delivery teams across locations, assess deliverable quality, remove technical blockers and hold suppliers accountable for agreed architecture, engineering and documentation standards.
  
  
Selection Criteria
  
  

* Master's degree with at least eight years of relevant experience, or bachelor's degree with at least ten years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience, in computer science, software engineering, information systems or a related field.
* Substantial recent experience architecting and delivering large-scale enterprise applications using Microsoft Dynamics 365, Dataverse, .NET and Azure.
* Demonstrated hands-on contribution to production solutions, including personal coding, prototyping, integration, troubleshooting and deployment responsibilities.
* Experience leading complex delivery across internal staff, vendors and globally distributed teams in environments with strong governance, security and operational requirements.
* At least seven years of experience developing and maintaining large-scale solutions using C# and the Microsoft .NET ecosystem.
* At least five years of experience architecting Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Dataverse solutions and integrations with SharePoint Online, Azure services and enterprise or on-premises systems.
* Proven experience leading large, complex technical deliverables and globally distributed development teams, including vendor or offshore delivery, in environments with shifting priorities and multi-layered governance.

**Required Technical Capabilities**

* Advanced Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Dataverse architecture, including data modelling, security, workflows, plug-ins, custom APIs, Power Platform extensibility and solution ALM.
* Advanced C# and modern .NET engineering, including ASP.NET Core, REST APIs, dependency injection, asynchronous programming, automated testing and secure coding.
* Strong Azure application architecture experience, including App Service, Functions, API Management, Service Bus, Key Vault, Application Insights, storage and container-based deployment patterns.
* Strong systems integration capability across APIs, events, enterprise applications, Microsoft 365 services, SharePoint Online and data platforms.
* Hands-on CI/CD and DevSecOps experience, including source control, branching, build and release pipelines, infrastructure/configuration automation, quality gates, secrets handling and rollback.
* Practical experience designing or implementing Generative AI and agentic capabilities, including tool calling, orchestration, retrieval, structured outputs, evaluation, observability and human oversight.
* Ability to apply SDLC and ADLC controls to move prototypes into secure, supportable and production-ready services.
* Strong security architecture knowledge covering identity, authorization, least privilege, data protection, auditability, threat modelling and secure integration.
* Ability to produce clear architecture documentation and to explain decisions, alternatives, risks and trade-offs to varied audiences.
* Hands-on experience extending Dynamics 365 using C#/.NET plug-ins, custom APIs, workflows and supported client-side technologies, with strong knowledge of Dataverse security, data modelling and reporting capabilities.
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization using Microsoft Entra ID, including B2E and approved B2B scenarios.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Operations Workspace, operational process platforms, project or portfolio management solutions, or comparable enterprise CRM/workflow ecosystems.
* Experience with Angular or React and modern web application integration with .NET and Dynamics 365 back ends.
* Experience with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Semantic Kernel or comparable enterprise agent frameworks.
* Experience with document intelligence, enterprise search, RAG, semantic layers, knowledge graphs or governed access to structured and unstructured information.
* Experience with SAFe, Agile Release Trains, product operating models and architecture governance.
* Experience in international development, financial services or another regulated environment with strong privacy, security and audit requirements.
* Relevant Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure, DevOps, security or architecture certifications.
* Working knowledge of enterprise data and analytics platforms, including data lakes, data warehouses, Power BI, Azure Data Factory, Databricks or comparable integration and analytics services.

**Recommended Certifications**

* Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Solution Architect Expert or relevant Dynamics 365 certification.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
* Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert.
* SAFe for Architects (ARCH) and/or SAFe DevOps (SDP).
* Relevant Microsoft applied skills or certifications in Azure AI, Azure OpenAI or Copilot Studio.

As the World Bank Group continues to evolve, we value candidates who:
  
  

* Demonstrate the ability to collaborate effectively across teams, disciplines, cultures, and institutional boundaries.
* Responsibly leverage digital and AI-enabled tools to enhance productivity, learning, and decision-making.
* Bring experience working in fragile, conflict-affected, and violent (FCV) contexts and are encouraged to highlight relevant experience in their application materials, where applicable.

**WBG Culture Attributes**

* Sense of urgency: Anticipate and quickly respond to the needs of internal and external stakeholders.
* Thoughtful risk-taking: Challenge the status quo and push boundaries to achieve greater impact.
* Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results.

World Bank Group Core Competencies
  
  
The World Bank Group offers comprehensive benefits, including a retirement plan; medical, life and disability insurance; and paid leave, including parental leave, as well as reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities.
  
  
We are proud to be an equal opportunity and inclusive employer with a dedicated and committed workforce, and do not discriminate based on gender, gender identity, religion, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or disability.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC300053
description:
**Description**
**Department/Project Description**
We are seeking a Forward-Deployed AI Product Architect to work at the intersection of core product engineering, AI orchestration, and high-impact client deployment. In this role, you will bridge the gap between our core AI platform capabilities and the highly regulated, complex workflows of our enterprise clients (specifically across FinTech, Financial Services, and Enterprise SaaS).
  
  
You are not just deploying a tool; you are embedding autonomous, intent-driven AI workflows into the client’s product ecosystem. This role requires a hands-on builder, deep product architect, and first-principles thinker who can gain trust with client developers and justify product ROI to executive stakeholders.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Job Responsibilities**
**Domain-Specific AI Integration**
Architect Intent-Driven Workflows: Design and deploy agentic AI workflows tailored to complex financial domain logic, ensuring systems can reliably process high-stakes data (e.g., automated credit underwriting analysis, regulatory compliance checking, or algorithmic fraud intent mapping).
  
  
Context-Aware RAG Pipelines: Build and optimize domain-specific Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector database architectures that ingest massive, disparate financial data sources (e.g., SEC filings, transaction ledgers, legacy ERP schemas) to feed localized AI agents.
  
  
Bridge Legacy Core Systems: Design secure abstraction layers and Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations that allow AI systems to interact seamlessly with legacy core-banking systems, monolithic financial ledgers, and rigid enterprise APIs.
  
  
**Product Delivery & SDLC Acceleration**
Accelerate Product Feature Delivery: Partner directly with the client’s product and engineering leadership to replace traditional, bottlenecked sprint cycles with autonomous delivery loops that generate domain-compliant code, comprehensive unit tests, and validation artifacts.
  
  
Establish Guardrails & AI Governance: Implement deterministic controls, “human-in-the-loop” verification, and automated compliance checks within the AI pipeline to meet strict financial sector regulatory standards (e.g., SEC, GDPR, SOC2).
  
  
Measure Engineering Velocity: Define, track, and report on hard product metrics resulting from AI implementation, such as reduction in feature-to-production cycle time, code review velocity, and coverage of automated edge-case test generation.
  
  
**Forward-Deployed Customer Engagement**
Embedded Engineering Leadership: Embed directly within client engineering teams as a trusted technical advisor, leading by example by writing code, evaluating architectures, and building working proofs of concept.
  
  
Translate Intent to Architecture: Map high-level business goals from client Product Managers into technical AI specifications, ensuring the AI agents accurately understand product requirements and domain constraints.
  
  
Executive Value Articulation: Present technical architectures, security postures, and measured business outcomes to both engineering teams and C-level executives (CTO, Chief Risk Officer, CPO).
  
  
Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi-agent orchestration, AI Observability
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
**Must-Have Qualifications And Experience**
Experience: 15+ years of experience in software engineering, enterprise product architecture, platform engineering, or solution architecture, with at least 5+ years spent delivering high-scale products within the Financial Services or Enterprise SaaS sectors.
  
  
Technical Fluency: Deep, hands-on fluency with the modern AI stack. You must be able to build, evaluate, and debug AI development tools, agentic frameworks, and IDE-based assistants.
  
  
Domain Expertise: Thorough understanding of financial technology standards, secure SDLC, DevSecOps, data privacy laws, and enterprise architecture patterns.
  
  
**Good-to-Have Skills**
Direct experience with tools/frameworks like Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, and vector databases.
  
  
Background in customer-facing technical roles such as Forward-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, or Technical Advisor.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**

title: Director - Principal Data Engineering Lead
description:
**Job Title: Director - Principal Data Engineering Lead**
**GCL: F**
**Location: Chennai**
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to turn the latest AI breakthroughs into resilient, production-grade systems that accelerate late-stage scientific discovery and move life-changing medicines closer to patients? Can you picture yourself setting enterprise-wide Data and AI strategy while building reusable autonomous frameworks and GenAI capabilities that scale with confidence?
  
  
In this role, you will lead how we embed intelligence into the digital backbone of drug development. You will develop long-term platform funding priorities, capability roadmaps, and technology choices. Then you will translate strategy into solutions that make complex enterprise workflows simpler, safer, and faster for our scientists and product teams.
  
  
Join us at a pivotal point in our transformation into a digital and data-led enterprise. Backed by investment and an ecosystem of partners, you will work across AI science, engineering and business partners to create patterns that become the standard and prove them through high-impact deliveries that stand up in a regulated environment.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Shape and evolve the long-term Data and AI strategy for drug development, including platform investments, capability roadmaps, technology choices and alignment with enterprise architecture.
* Partner with AI science teams to design reusable agentic patterns, GenAI components and scalable solutions that streamline sophisticated enterprise workflows and accelerate delivery.
* Influence enterprise architecture decisions and lead strategic vendor evaluations, pilots and ecosystem partnerships to bring the best technologies into the enterprise.
* Lead multi-functional engineering teams, driving end-to-end delivery from prototype to robust, compliant production systems.
* Define, govern and promote engineering standards, guidelines and reusable design patterns; produce and review detailed technical designs across data models, APIs, integrations, security, deployment, error handling, performance, monitoring, testing and support.
* Promote strong data integrity and governance, including clear ownership, quality management, metadata, lineage, audit trails, master and reference data, and standardized terminology.
* Establish and maintain AI and ML governance controls, covering risk assessment, proper use, human oversight, explainability, model approval, versioning, performance monitoring, change control and retirement.
* Implement production-grade controls for GenAI and retrieval-augmented generation solutions to deliver reliable, traceable and secure outputs based on trusted information, including prompt and model management, response quality testing, source referencing, access controls and mitigations for prompt attacks and data leakage.
* Define and operate comprehensive evaluation and monitoring frameworks that track accuracy, reliability, security, response quality, business relevance, degradation, latency, cost and operational stability.
* Establish API-based and event-driven integration standards, including data formats, contracts, versioning, interoperability and integration with legacy and regulated systems.
* Improve value from enterprise data platforms and guide the implementation of DevOps, DataOps and MLOps practices to deliver resilient, automated, auditable pipelines across data, ML and AI.
* Ensure data solutions adhere to FAIR principles—findable, accessible, interoperable and reusable—and support end-to-end machine learning and AI workflows.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, experimentation, collaboration, and innovation across engineering and AI teams, encouraging thoughtful use of AI and digital tools in day-to-day work.

**Essential Skills/Experience**

* Track record of leading end-to-end delivery of AI-native products within a controlled or enterprise environment.
* Demonstrable ability translating research advances in GenAI or agent-based systems into scalable industrial solutions.
* Deep knowledge of modern cloud and data architecture patterns: microservices, serverless, etc.
* Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), SQL/NoSQL databases, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Fluency in Python, with a good understanding of secure software engineering practices.
* Experience mentoring engineers and leading high-performing teams.
* Comfortable influencing senior partners and shaping technology strategy across functions.

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Pharma industry experience, particularly in R&D or Late-Stage Development.
* AI or Gen AI technical certifications or equivalent.
* AWS Cloud Certification or equivalent.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.
  
  
**Why AstraZeneca**
Here, your work directly accelerates the development of life-changing medicines by pairing leading science with modern data platforms, analytics and AI. You will join a community that brings unconventional combinations of expertise together to spark bold thinking, supported by real investment and the freedom to experiment—from hackathons to high-impact deliveries in production. We value kindness alongside ambition, recognize meaningful contributions and create space for diverse minds to collaborate, learn fast and shape how an entire enterprise uses data and AI to create patient impact.
  
  
**Call To Action**
Step into this role to architect the AI foundations of drug development and amplify your impact—share your profile and start shaping what’s next.
  
  
**Date Posted**
13-Oct-2026
  
  
**Closing Date**
AstraZeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AIA - AI Archictect- Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**AI Architect**
**Enterprise GenAI, Agentic AI and AI Platform Architecture**
**Career Family AIA - AI / GenAI / Agentic AI**
**Role Type Full Time**
**The opportunity**
We are seeking an experienced AI Architect to lead the design and delivery of secure, scalable and production-ready enterprise AI solutions. The role combines hands-on architecture with consulting leadership across Generative AI, Agentic AI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI/ML, cloud platforms and modern application engineering. The architect will translate business priorities into target-state architectures, reusable patterns and implementation roadmaps while guiding multidisciplinary teams from discovery through deployment and operationalization.
  
  
The ideal candidate has delivered enterprise or client-facing AI solutions in pre-production or production environments and can explain the use case, architecture, personal contribution, controls, delivery approach and outcomes. Certifications, personal projects and demonstrations alone are not sufficient.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead discovery and architecture workshops, clarify business outcomes and non-functional requirements, and convert them into scalable AI solution designs and delivery roadmaps.
* Architect LLM applications, copilots, RAG and Graph RAG solutions, autonomous agents, multi-agent workflows, tool/function calling, memory patterns and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Define reference architectures and reusable patterns for document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, grounding, prompt workflows, model routing and enterprise integrations.
* Select fit-for-purpose models, cloud services, vector stores, orchestration frameworks and evaluation approaches based on security, quality, latency, cost, scalability and maintainability requirements.
* Design API-first, event-driven and microservices-based integrations with enterprise applications, data platforms, workflow systems and user experience layers.
* Establish AI evaluation and observability covering retrieval quality, groundedness, accuracy, hallucination risk, agent trajectories, tool execution, latency, cost and user experience.
* Embed Responsible AI, privacy, security and compliance controls including PII protection, access control, auditability, prompt-injection mitigation, content safety, secure tool execution and data-leakage prevention.
* Define cloud-native deployment and operations patterns using containers, Kubernetes or managed services, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, model/LLM operations, monitoring and release controls.
* Lead architecture reviews, technical design reviews, code reviews and production-readiness assessments; troubleshoot complex issues and guide performance optimization.
* Partner with business stakeholders, product owners, data scientists, engineers, UX teams, security and platform teams to ensure alignment from design through adoption.
* Contribute to proposals, RFP responses, estimates, executive presentations, accelerators, reusable assets and AI practice development.
* Lead and mentor architects and engineers, promote engineering standards, and build capability through coaching and knowledge sharing.

**Skills And Attributes**
**Professional experience**

* 10+ years of experience in AI, data, analytics, software engineering or digital transformation, including significant responsibility for solution architecture and end-to-end delivery.
* Strong hands-on experience designing and deploying enterprise-scale AI/ML, GenAI, RAG or Agentic AI solutions in client-facing environments.
* Proven experience leading cross-functional teams, architecture governance, stakeholder engagement and complex delivery programs.
* Ability to communicate architecture decisions, trade-offs and business value to technical and executive audiences.

**Technical Skills**

* Deep understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, Graph RAG, Agentic RAG, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, knowledge graphs, model evaluation and fine-tuning approaches.
* Hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI or Google Agent SDK, and familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Strong experience with at least one enterprise cloud AI ecosystem: Microsoft Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI; AWS Bedrock; or GCP Vertex AI and Gemini. Multi-cloud exposure is preferred.
* Experience with data and AI platforms such as Databricks, Azure AI Search, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, BigQuery or equivalent enterprise data services.
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL; working knowledge of REST APIs, FastAPI, JSON, asynchronous processing, microservices and event-driven architecture.
* Experience with vector databases, enterprise search, relational and NoSQL data stores, caching and analytics stores.
* Understanding of ML, deep learning, NLP, predictive analytics and the end-to-end AI lifecycle.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes or OpenShift, Git, CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure as code, MLOps, LLMOps, observability and production support.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise architecture, data governance, model risk, Responsible AI, privacy, cybersecurity, accessibility and regulatory controls.

**Consulting And Leadership Skills**

* Strong client engagement, workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, presentation and executive communication skills.
* Ability to translate complex business requirements into practical, high-quality technical architectures and phased implementation plans.
* Leadership in solution estimation, delivery governance, risk management, quality assurance, mentoring and capability building.
* Curiosity, structured problem-solving, commercial awareness and commitment to continuous learning.

**Education And Preferred Certifications**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics or a related quantitative discipline.
* Relevant certifications in Azure AI, AWS, Google Cloud, Databricks, AI/ML, Generative AI or enterprise architecture are preferred.

**Why join us**

* Be at the forefront of AI-driven innovation across multiple client sectors.
* Work with global clients to deliver measurable business impact.
* Collaborate with AI experts, analytics leaders and industry specialists in a highly entrepreneurial environment.

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We provide the tools and flexibility so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We provide insights, coaching and confidence to help you become the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be empowered to use your voice and help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
