description:
**Who We Are**
Arcadia is the AI-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.
  
  
Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and
****cut carbon****
.
  
  
**We Deliver This Through Three Comprehensive Solutions**

* Utility Bill Management: Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle — from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing.
* Energy Procurement Advisory: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all.
* Sustainability Reporting — Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms.

Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Competitive compensation based on market standards
* We are working on a hybrid model with remote first policy
* Apart from Fixed Base Salary potential candidates are eligible for following benefits


+ Flexible Leave Policy
+ Office located in the heart of the city in case you need to step in for any purpose

* We provide comprehensive coverage including accident policy and life insurance.
* Medical Insurance (1+5 Family Members)
* Flexible Benefit Plan
* Awards and Bonus
* Annual performance cycle
* Quarterly engagement activities
* A supportive engineering culture that values diversity, empathy, teamwork, trust, and efficiency

**What We’re Looking For**
We are seeking a
****Senior Staff Engineer (L6)****
to join Core Engineering in India as a senior individual contributor operating across squads rather than inside one. You will be the technical subject matter expert our teams pull in when the problem is hard, the design is ambiguous, or the blast radius is large — moving between our Acquisition, Extraction and Storage, and Presentment squads as priorities shift.
  
  
This role exists because our squads are shipping faster than our design review capacity. We have driven deep adoption of AI-assisted development across India engineering, and the constraint has moved: teams can now produce architecture and implementations quickly, but senior validation of those designs concentrates on too few people. You will be one of a small number of engineers trusted to review and approve significant designs, and to raise the design ceiling of the engineers around you.
  
  
You will not have direct reports. Your influence comes from technical depth, design judgment, and mentorship rather than reporting lines. This is a hybrid, remote-first role anchored in Chennai, working daily with US-based engineering and product partners.
  
  
Our engineering values are deeply ingrained in our culture — you can read more about them here.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Act as the floating technical SME across Core Engineering squads, embedding where the hardest current problem is and moving on once the team is self-sufficient
* Review and approve component and service designs, sharing design authority with squad leads so that architecture approval stops being a single-person bottleneck
* Own the design of complex, cross-service changes spanning multiple owners — provider data model changes, extraction pipeline evolution, migrations, and event contract changes
* Write production code on the critical path. This is a hands-on role; you will be in the repositories, not only in documents
* Set and raise the bar on non-functional requirements: performance, scalability, reliability, observability, and cost across the services you touch
* Validate AI-generated designs and implementations, reviewing agent output for architectural soundness, hidden coupling, and failure modes the model did not consider
* Advance how we do AI-assisted engineering: spec-driven development, reusable skills and subagents, prompt patterns that hold up against our codebase, and automation of recurring work
* Mentor Staff Engineers and below through pairing, design review, and constructive feedback, measurably lifting the technical judgment of the squads you rotate through
* Lead major refactoring and technical debt reduction across legacy platform services, sequencing the work so that delivery continues
* Debug and resolve complex production issues that cross service, data, and infrastructure boundaries
* Write the design documents, architecture decision records, and runbooks that make your decisions durable. Confluence is our single source of truth
* Partner with US engineering leads on cross-region initiatives, representing India engineering in architecture discussions

**What Will Help You Succeed**
The following list reflects our current technology stack. You will need meaningful overlap or analogous experience, but not an exact match.
  
  
****Must-haves****

* 10–12+ years in software engineering, with a track record of owning technically complex, multi-service work end to end
* Deep production expertise in Python, plus working fluency in a second ecosystem such as Java and Spring Boot or TypeScript/Node

title: Senior Director, Engineering - AI Studio (CX & EX)
description:
Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.

**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**

At Freshworks, we build uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional customer and employee experiences. Our enterprise-grade solutions are powerful, yet easy to use, and quick to deliver results. Our people-first approach to AI eliminates friction, making employees more effective and organizations more productive. Over 72,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks’ customer experience (CX) and employee experience (EX) software to fuel customer loyalty and service efficiency. And, over 4,500 Freshworks employees make this possible, all around the world.

***Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.***

**Job Description**

At Freshworks, we are building the future of customer and employee engagement - and AI agents are at the center of it. The AI Agent Platform is the foundation on which our next generation of autonomous and assistive experiences are built. AI Studio is the product surface that brings that platform to life: the place where builders design, test, deploy, observe, and continuously optimize AI agents that ship inside our CX and EX products.
  
  
We are looking for a visionary engineering leader to own AI Studio end to end. As the Senior Director of Engineering for AI Studio, you will lead a dynamic, multi-disciplinary organization that builds the front-end experience and the Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) layer for the AI Agent Platform, and embeds these capabilities natively within our CX and EX product lines. This is a pivotal, high-visibility role with the opportunity to shape how thousands of businesses build and operate AI agents - setting the bar for craftsmanship, developer experience, reliability, and scale.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead a dynamic, multi-disciplinary organization of engineers and engineering managers spanning front-end, BFF/services, and platform integration.
* Own the vision and technical execution for AI Studio - the end-to-end experience to build, test, deploy, observe, and optimize AI agents on the AI Agent Platform.
* Deliver a best-in-class front end and a robust Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) layer that expose the AI Agent Platform’s capabilities to builders with speed, trust, and clarity.
* Embed AI Studio natively within both CX and EX product lines, ensuring a seamless, consistent builder and end-user experience across surfaces.
* Establish the agent lifecycle as a first-class product: authoring and configuration, testing and evaluation, safe deployment, live observability, and data-driven optimization.
* Partner deeply with the AI Agent Platform, AI/ML, and Data Science teams to surface state-of-the-art models, tools, and orchestration capabilities through intuitive workflows.
* Define and track impact: agent build velocity, time-to-deploy, adoption, agent quality and containment/deflection, reliability, and measurable ROI for CX and EX customers.
* Establish governance and trust: access controls, guardrails, data classification, privacy/PII handling, auditability, and compliance-ready practices for agent workflows.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Set the AI Studio vision:**
  Define the strategy, roadmap, and operating model for a unified studio experience that lets builders create, test, deploy, observe, and optimize AI agents across CX and EX.
* **Own the full builder journey:**
  Ship the front-end and BFF that make agent authoring, configuration, and iteration fast, intuitive, and reliable - from first prototype to production at scale.
* **Deliver testing & evaluation:**
  Build the tooling for agent testing, simulation, and evaluation (quality, safety, regression) so teams ship agents with confidence and measurable quality bars.
* **Enable safe, scalable deployment:**
  Provide deployment, versioning, and rollout controls that let teams promote agents across environments with strong guardrails and zero-downtime expectations.
* **Build observability & optimization:**
  Deliver real-time monitoring, tracing, and analytics for live agents - surfacing quality, latency, cost, and outcome signals - and close the loop so insights drive continuous optimization.
* **Embed across CX & EX:**
  Ensure AI Studio integrates natively into Freshworks CX and EX products, delivering a consistent experience while respecting the needs of each product line.
* **Lead & inspire:**
  Cultivate a high-performance, inclusive culture across a multi-tiered organization of engineers and managers. Mentor the next generation of technical leaders and build a team known for technical excellence and execution velocity.
* **Execute with excellence:**
  Master the full development lifecycle, from strategic planning and roadmap management to deployment and operations. Champion agile, iterative delivery to ship exceptional products under ambitious deadlines and evolving priorities.
* **Drive technical & architectural strategy:**
  Act as the technical authority for AI Studio. Guide teams in building large-scale, distributed cloud systems, performant front-end architectures, and resilient BFF/API layers, adopting best practices and emerging AI technologies.
* **Collaborate to win:**
  Build powerful partnerships with AI Agent Platform, AI/ML, Product, Design, and GTM leaders so the AI Studio roadmap is aligned with platform capabilities, business needs, and customer expectations. Foster a “one team” mindset.
* **Champion innovation & quality:**
  Foster continuous improvement and out-of-the-box thinking. Establish and track KPIs that measure AI Studio health, reliability, builder productivity, and business impact.

**Qualifications**

**What You’ll Bring**

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 15+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, with a proven track record of at least 5 years in a senior leadership role (Director or above) leading product-facing platform, developer-tooling, or application engineering teams.
* Demonstrable experience building, scaling, and leading high-performing product and engineering organizations in an enterprise SaaS environment.
* Strong technical foundation in building and operating large-scale, distributed systems on public cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), including modern front-end architectures and Backend-for-Frontend (BFF)/API design.
* Hands-on understanding of the AI/agent landscape: LLMs, agent orchestration, RAG, evaluation and observability for AI systems, and the practical realities of shipping AI features into production.
* Track record of delivering builder- or developer-facing products (studios, low-code/no-code tooling, or platform consoles) with excellent UX and reliability at scale.

**Skills Inventory:**

**Leadership & Talent Management**

* Inspirational leadership & mentorship
* Talent acquisition & retention
* Organizational design & scaling
* Performance management & career development

**Technical & Architectural Acumen**

* Front-end architecture & Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) design
* Cloud computing, microservices & large-scale distributed systems
* AI agent platforms: LLMs, orchestration, evaluation & AI observability
* DevOps, CI/CD, and SRE principles
* Data security, guardrails & compliance frameworks

**Strategic & Business Acumen**

* Long-term strategic planning & vision setting
* Roadmap development & prioritization
* Budget & resource management
* Data-driven decision making & KPI management

**Execution & Collaboration**

* Agile & iterative development methodologies
* Cross-functional influence & stakeholder management
* Exceptional communication & interpersonal skills
* Problem-solving & crisis management

**Additional Information**

**Please note this is a hybrid role that requires an in-office presence 3 days / week (Tue-Thu).**

Freshservice is expanding what “AI-driven ITSM” means for our customers — from Freddy AI Copilot and Freddy AI Agent, to Agent Studio for building custom agentic workflows, to MCP Gateway connecting Freshservice to the broader AI stack. We're creating a new kind of Solutions Engineering role to match: the Lead AI Solution Engineer.

This is a specialist presales role for someone who can do three things at once: speak credibly to technical and business buyers about AI value, architect and demo AI solutions on top of Freshservice, and stay hands-on enough to help customers get those solutions live post-sale. You'll be the AI subject-matter expert embedded in SMB and Commercial deals, partnering with Account Executives, core SEs, Product, and Professional Services to win competitive deals and make sure the AI value we sell is the AI value customers actually realize.

You'll report into the Solutions Engineering leadership team and act as a force multiplier for the broader SE org — enabling peers, building reusable AI demo assets, and representing the voice of the customer back to Product on where our AI roadmap needs to go next.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the technical narrative for AI/Freddy across strategic and competitive deals — positioning Freddy AI Copilot, Freddy AI Agent, Agent Studio, and MCP Gateway against how prospects actually work today, not a generic AI pitch.
* Design and deliver tailored AI proofs-of-concept and demos: configuring agentic workflows, custom skills, and automations in Agent Studio, and connecting Freshservice to customer data and tools via MCP Gateway and APIs.
* Lead technical discovery specifically for AI use cases — ticket deflection, agent-assist, workflow automation, knowledge management — quantifying expected impact (deflection rate, resolution time, agent productivity) with the customer, not just for them.
* Lead internal projects that improve Solution Engineering efficiency and productivity, identifying repetitive processes and building AI driven workflows to simplify or automate them.
* Partner with Account Executives and core Solution Engineers as the AI overlay specialist on SMB, Commercial and competitive pursuits, joining deals at the point where AI differentiation matters most.
* Support deal-winning activities end to end: RFP/RFI responses, executive briefings, proof-of-value engagements, and security/architecture reviews for AI components (data handling, model governance, integration security).
* Bridge presales to delivery: work with Professional Services and Customer Success to help scope and de-risk the implementation of AI solutions sold, so what was demoed is what gets deployed.
* Build and maintain a library of reusable AI demo environments, reference architectures, and ROI/business-case models that the wider SE team can self-serve.
* Track competitive AI positioning versus ServiceNow (Now Assist), SysAid, Quest KACE, and other ITSM/ITAM players — including where competitors are genuinely ahead, so the team's positioning stays credible rather than one-sided.
* Represent customer and field feedback on AI features and gaps directly to Product and Engineering, influencing roadmap prioritization.
* Mentor and enable other SEs on AI positioning, demo technique, and objection handling as the internal go-to expert.

**Qualifications**

**What You'll Bring**

* 8+ years in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solution Consulting, or Technical Presales, ideally within ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, or broader enterprise SaaS.
* Strong AI fundamentals. You deeply understand how LLMs and agents work in production: context engineering, memory, RAG, tool use, structured outputs, and the failure modes that actually show up at scale. You've worked with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Google ADK, or equivalent) and with both open and closed source models.
* Hands-on experience deploying or configuring AI/LLM-based solutions in a customer-facing context — this can be conversational AI/copilots, RAG-based knowledge assistants, or agentic workflow automation; deep AI/ML research experience is required.
* Hands on expectations around building internal agents and automations. For example, creating agents that can interact with multiple internal systems, collect and consolidate information from different sources, reason across that context, and provide actionable recommendations or trigger downstream workflows.
* A track record of selling and positioning AI or automation value to both business stakeholders (ROI, productivity, risk) and technical stakeholders (architecture, security, integration). Experience building production-grade machine learning deployments on AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Experience running competitive deals and building honest, differentiated positioning rather than one-size-fits-all pitches.
* Comfort operating across the full deal lifecycle — from discovery and demo through proof-of-value and into implementation handoff.
* Excellent executive presence and communication skills; able to flex a technical AI conversation up to a CIO/CX-leader audience or down to a hands-on admin audience in the same week.
* Freshservice, Freshdesk, or comparable ITSM/CX platform experience (ServiceNow, SysAid, Zendesk, Jira Service Management) is a strong plus.

* Experience with ITAM/discovery tooling (e.g., Device42) and how it feeds AI-driven automation.

As an AI Security Consultant specializing in Infrastructure in Deloitte Cyber's Cyber for AI practice, you will own technical workstreams that secure the cloud, network, container and model-serving foundations used to run generative AI and agentic workloads. You will combine client advisory with hands-on engineering, turning requirements into architectures, integrations and production controls. You will guide junior practitioners, lead demonstrations and help estimate delivery work.
  
  
Work you'll do
  
  
As an AI Security Consultant on the Infrastructure team, you will be responsible for
  
  

* Build secure AI landing-zone components across cloud accounts or subscriptions, networks, identity, compute, Kubernetes, model services and observability.
* Design and deploy secure AI landing zones and model-serving environments across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud or Kubernetes-based platforms.
* Lead implementation of network isolation, private access, egress controls, cluster security, secrets, artifact controls, IaC and policy enforcement.
* Engineer and review Kubernetes and model-serving patterns for tenant isolation, GPU workloads, autoscaling, resilience and controlled enterprise integration.
* Plan and execute platform security, resilience and operational testing, diagnose complex failures, and drive issues through resolution.
* Own an infrastructure workstream, manage dependencies and milestones, and provide day-to-day guidance to consultants.
* Lead technical demonstrations and prototypes, and contribute architecture, effort and estimation inputs to pursuits.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:
  
  

* Ability to independently lead a technical workstream and manage priorities, dependencies and delivery commitments.
* Clear communication of architecture decisions, technical tradeoffs, risks and implementation status to engineering and business stakeholders.
* Ability to guide consultants, review technical work and create a collaborative delivery environment.
* Strong demonstration and technical storytelling skills for workshops, prototypes and client readouts.

The team
  
  
Deloitte Cyber's Cyber for AI practice helps organizations secure generative AI and agentic systems from design through production. The team brings together AI engineering and cyber skills across identity, data, infrastructure, application security and operations.
  
  
We work with clients to make security controls part of the platform and delivery lifecycle, so teams can move from experiments to production without creating unmanaged access, data or infrastructure risk.
  
  
Within the practice, the Infrastructure capability focuses on secure AI landing zones, cloud and network architecture, container and model-serving platforms, policy automation and observability.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related field; alternatively, equivalent demonstrated experience.
* 2+ years of combined cybersecurity and AI engineering experience, including hands-on production work in both domains.
* Hands-on experience designing, integrating and securing production generative AI, RAG or agentic workloads, including model, tool and enterprise data connections.
* Hands-on depth in AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, with working knowledge of infrastructure security patterns in the other major cloud platforms.
* Strong hands-on experience designing and securing cloud and network infrastructure, Kubernetes or container platforms, and production AI or model-serving workloads.
* Strong knowledge of network segmentation, private connectivity, egress controls, DNS, TLS, firewalls, gateways, service meshes and enterprise integration patterns.
* Implementation experience with Terraform or comparable IaC, CI/CD pipelines, policy-as-code, Kubernetes RBAC, network policies, admission controls and secrets.
* Ability to design, build and review infrastructure automation using Python, Go, Bash, PowerShell or a comparable language, together with HCL or YAML, Git and CI/CD tooling.
* Ability to travel 25% to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and engagements you serve.

Preferred:
  
  

* Previous consulting, client delivery or customer-facing engineering experience.
* Experience across both managed AI services and self-hosted or open-weight AI platforms.
* Experience with AI threat modeling, red teaming, security evaluations, secure AI development practices or AI-specific monitoring.
* Experience developing reusable technical assets, guiding junior engineers or contributing to engineering standards.
* Familiarity with the broader machine learning lifecycle and frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or MLflow.
* Experience with AI platforms and model-serving technologies such as Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore or SageMaker AI; Microsoft Foundry or Azure Machine Learning; Google Vertex AI; vLLM; KServe; NVIDIA Triton or NIM; Ray Serve; or comparable platforms.
* Experience securing GPU infrastructure, model and container registries, software supply chains, signed artifacts, service meshes or multi-tenant inference environments.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CKA, CKS, or cloud and Terraform certifications

title: Senior Machine Learning/AI Operations Engineer
description:
As a
**Senior Machine Learning/AI Operations Engineer**
, you will develop and operate the infrastructure, tooling, and workflows that enable effective use of AI and Machine Learning at CMT. Your responsibilities will span operationalizing AI developer tools and model services, automating model workflows, and improving reliability, observability, and cost efficiency. You will partner with Engineering, Machine Learning, Compliance, Security Engineering, and SRE to translate their requirements into operational capabilities and controls.
  
  
You will apply reproducible workflows, evaluation, controlled deployment, monitoring, and incident response to existing developer harnesses and coding tools, large language model (LLM) applications and agents, and machine learning training and inference. Current priorities emphasize AI usage across engineering teams, with shared operational ownership of model development and release infrastructure. The role requires hands-on expertise in scalable AI/ML systems, independent technical judgment, and the ability to turn operational needs into reusable capabilities.
  
  
CMT is looking for a collaborative, customer-committed, and creative
**Senior Machine Learning/AI Operations Engineer**
who wants to join us in making roads safer by making drivers better!
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Develop and optimize scalable AI/ML infrastructure, ensuring a balance between cost-efficiency and speed, with the goal of empowering Engineering and Machine Learning teams
* Operationalize AI developer harnesses, coding tools, and shared model services by tuning model configurations, integrating tools into engineering workflows, evaluating their effectiveness, and implementing usage controls agreed with Compliance and Security Engineering
* Optimize model access and inference through routing, rate limits, retries, timeouts, and fallbacks. Monitor token usage, latency, efficiency, throughput, and costs. Attribute usage and costs by team and workload, and implement budgets, quotas, and capacity controls
* Establish monitoring infrastructure for evaluating the performance of AI applications and machine learning models at scale. Trace model calls, retrieval, tool execution, and training workflows; monitor data quality, model drift, and output quality; and implement safeguards for sensitive data and tool access
* Operationalize evaluation workflows for models, prompts, and AI tool configurations. Work with Engineering and Machine Learning teams to track quality metrics and detect regressions, and with Compliance, Security Engineering, and SRE to incorporate policy, security, and reliability requirements into evaluation workflows and deployment decisions
* Develop and manage reproducible agent, training, and evaluation workflows, including permissions, execution limits, failure recovery, and traceability of inputs and outputs
* Build robust infrastructure to expedite the delivery of new models and AI capabilities, enhancing the efficiency of experimentation, validation, and deployment. Automate versioning, experiment tracking, model registries, release pipelines, retraining, and rollback
* Manage, configure, deploy, and troubleshoot AI/ML workloads on AWS and Kubernetes/EKS. Automate infrastructure with Terraform, Helm, and Argo CD, and optimize CPU/GPU capacity and autoscaling for training and inference
* Partner with SRE, Engineering, and Machine Learning teams to define operational metrics and service-level objectives, investigate production issues, and conduct root-cause analysis for model services, AI tools, and training pipelines. Coordinate with Security Engineering and Compliance when incidents involve security or policy concerns, and implement improvements that prevent recurring failures
* Design and document systems, including writing and reviewing code, to automate operational problems within the team's domain. Evaluate emerging AI/ML tools and operational practices against workload requirements, reliability, security, and cost, and mentor teammates
* Architect software solutions integrating developer tools, backend, and research domains, facilitating effective data collection and transmission to support AI applications and ML models. Build and optimize ingestion, retrieval, feature engineering, model training, and validation pipelines using Databricks, Spark, Ray, and AWS services

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience and/or certification in a related field
* 4+ years of relevant working experience, with experience working as an AI / ML Operations Engineer a plus
* Demonstrated experience independently designing, delivering, and operating production AI/ML infrastructure, with ownership of technical decisions, deployment, reliability, and operational improvements.
* Hands-on experience integrating and operating LLM services or AI tools, including model APIs, provider quotas, context and token limits, and failure handling
* Experience with model training, validation, deployment, and monitoring, including reproducibility, experiment tracking, model versioning, and evaluation-driven releases.
* Experience with big data infrastructure and software, such as Databricks, SageMaker, Spark, and S3
* Strong Python programming skills and experience with SQL and shell scripting for model integrations, data processing, and operational automation. Familiarity with libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn.
* Hands-on experience with containerization and Kubernetes, including management, configuration, deployment, and troubleshooting
* Ability to design and document systems, including writing and reviewing code, to automate operational problems across AI/ML workflows.
* Good understanding of AWS services, including model services such as Amazon Bedrock or SageMaker, and experience with infrastructure as code and CI/CD using tools such as Terraform, Helm, or Argo CD.
* Demonstrated experience with production monitoring, and troubleshooting model, data, and infrastructure issues
* Ability to navigate code, retrieve data from data sources, and implement bug fixes; actively seeks feedback and resolves discrepancies with teammates
* Ability to collaborate across Engineering, Machine Learning, Compliance, Security Engineering, and SRE teams, translate their requirements into AI/ML operational practices and controls, evaluate technical tradeoffs, drive implementation through production rollout, and mentor engineers

**Nice to Haves:**

* Experience operating AI developer harnesses, coding tools, or agent workflows, including tool integrations, permissions, and usage management
* Experience with AI evaluation and tracing tools such as Langfuse or LangSmith, or ML lifecycle tools such as MLflow or Kubeflow
* Experience using EC2, Lambda, DynamoDB, RDS/PostgreSQL, NGINX, S3, and Kinesis in production environments
* Experience building scalable data processing systems for production environments, including retrieval, embedding, or feature pipelines
* Experience with deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, Keras, or PyTorch, including visualization and performance analysis
* Experience with GPU provisioning, model serving, or training and inference optimization

title: Algorithm Manager
description:
**Company Overview**
 KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
   

  

**Group/Division**
 With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next\-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost\-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The LS\-SWIFT Division of KLA’s Global Products Group provides patterned wafer inspection systems for high\-volume semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to deliver market\-leading cost of ownership in defect detection for a broad range of applications in the production of semiconductors. Customers from the foundry, logic, memory, automotive, MEMS, advanced packaging and other markets rely upon high\-sample wafer inspection information generated by LS\-SWIFT products. LS (Laser Scanning) systems enable cost\-effective patterned wafer defect detection for the industry’s most sophisticated process technologies deployed in leading\-edge foundry, logic, DRAM, and NAND fabs. SWIFT (Simultaneous Wafer Inspection at Fast Throughput) systems deliver all\-wafer\-surface (frontside, backside, and edge) macro inspection that is critical for automotive IC, MEMS, and advanced packaging processes as well as foundry/logic and memory fabs. LS\-SWIFT operates from a global footprint that includes the US, Singapore, India and Germany, and serves a worldwide customer base across Asia, Europe and North America.
   

  

**Job Description/Preferred Qualifications**
 Responsibilities:
   

  

* Provide technical leadership in algorithm design and development for wafer inspection products.
* Collaborate with system, product, and domain experts to define algorithm performance requirements and deliver customer‑driven solutions.
* Mentor and motivate engineers to solve complex technical and investigative problems.
* Represent the algorithms team during system‑level hardware and software integration.
* Develop, validate, and deploy image processing, computer vision, and machine learning algorithms.
* Support software quality and reliability activities as part of the development lifecycle.


 Qualifications:
   

  

* Strong background in image processing and computer vision; working knowledge of machine learning and deep learning.
* Proficient in C/C\+\+ and MATLAB; experience on Unix/Linux platforms.
* Hands‑on experience with object‑oriented and/or functional programming.
* Python and ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow) experience is a plus.
* Strong problem‑solving skills with the ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced environment.
* Good communication and collaboration skills with emerging technical leadership capability.


**Minimum Qualifications**
 PhD in CS/EE/Math/Physics with 3\+ years of experience, or MTech/MS/BTech/BS in CS/EE with 6\+ years of experience.
   

  

*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*

* Curious and experimental: rapid prototyping, A/B testing, iterative improvement.
* Ownership and accountability: proactive risk management, transparent communication.


**Qualifications**
* 6–10\+ years in Client\-Facing Technical roles (e.g., Solutions Architect, Pre\-Sales Engineer, AI Consultant).
* 3\+ years hands\-on with AI/ML, LLM applications, or automation platforms.
* Bachelor’s/Master’s in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* Experience in at least one enterprise vertical (e.g., BFSI, Manufacturing, Retail, Healthcare) is a plus.
* Certifications in cloud/AI (Azure AI Engineer, AWS ML Specialty, GCP ML Engineer) preferred.


**Typical WorkNEXT AI Use\-Case Areas (Adjust to your modules)**

* Process automation: ticket triage, claim summarization, email drafting, task routing.
* Insight generation: summarization of meetings/chats, trend analysis, risk alerts.
* Employee experience: HR policy assistant, IT helpdesk copilot, onboarding flows.
* Compliance \& governance: redaction, PII detection, audit\-ready conversation logs.


**Tools \& Tech Stack (Illustrative)**
* Cloud \& Infra: Azure (OpenAI, Cognitive Search), AWS (Bedrock, Sagemaker), GCP (Vertex AI).
* Data: Databricks/Snowflake/BigQuery; ETL tools (ADF, Airflow), vector stores (Pinecone, FAISS).
* Integration: REST/GraphQL APIs, iPaaS (MuleSoft, Boomi), event buses (Kafka).

The Digital Pricing team is at the forefront of leveraging AI and machine learning to compute millions of prices across our digital products. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to help design and build the next generation of our AI\-powered pricing systems.
   

  

 As a SDE, You'll will develop next generation pricing systems that process millions of prices daily. Our platform combines pricing strategies with advanced AI models, including Large Language Models (LLMs), GenAI and custom neural networks, to make real\-time pricing decisions that directly impact our business and customers.
   

  

 Joining the Digital Pricing team means taking on a role where technical expertise meets real\-world impact. From the outset, you’ll work with advanced AI technologies to develop solutions that power pricing across Amazon’s extensive digital products. This team is not only building innovative pricing systems—but also redefining how millions of customers experience Amazon’s digital products.
   

  

 The technical challenges you'll tackle are unique. You'll work with advanced AWS infrastructure, design distributed systems at massive scale, and implement AI solutions that directly impact Amazon's digital business. Whether you're optimising model performance, or developing new pricing systems, you'll have the resources and support to succeed.
   

  

 By joining Digital Pricing, you're not just changing teams – you're accelerating your career while solving complex challenges that matter. We're committed to helping you become the best engineer you can be, all while working on systems that shape Amazon's future.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

description:

Internally, you will use these client insights to architect and build the next generation of AI\-powered tools and workflows, radically optimizing our own data annotation processes. title: Lead Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
 Arcadia is the AI\-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.
   

  

 Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI\-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and
 ****cut carbon****
 .
   

  

**We Deliver This Through Three Comprehensive Solutions**
* Utility Bill Management: Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle — from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing.
* Energy Procurement Advisory: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI\-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all.
* Sustainability Reporting — Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms.


 Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Competitive compensation based on market standards
* We are working on a hybrid model with remote first policy
* Apart from Fixed Base Salary potential candidates are eligible for following benefits
* 
+ Flexible Leave Policy
+ Office located in the heart of the city in case you need to step in for any purpose

* We provide comprehensive coverage including accident policy and life insurance.
* Medical Insurance (1\+5 Family Members)
* Flexible Benefit Plan
* Awards and Bonus
* Annual performance cycle
* Quarterly engagement activities
* A supportive engineering culture that values diversity, empathy, teamwork, trust, and efficiency


**What We're Looking For**
 We are seeking a Lead Engineer to be the technical anchor of our Growth \& Governance (GnG) squad in India — the team that acquires utility data from thousands of unreliable third\-party sources, extracts and audits it, and turns it into the trusted dataset the rest of the Arcadia platform is built on. Formats change without notice, sources fail silently, and correctness is visible to customers, so our core expertise is building systems that stay accurate against data that refuses to cooperate.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role with real ownership. You will own architecture for one or more of our services, lead projects end to end, act as a second point of technical review alongside the Engineering Manager, and mentor a team of earlier\-career engineers.
   

  

 AI has moved where the hard part of engineering sits. Producing code is no longer the bottleneck; deciding whether the produced code is the
 **right**
 answer is. We are looking for someone already well ahead on AI\-driven development who also has the architectural judgment to reject its confident wrong answers — and to teach a team of earlier\-career engineers to do the same rather than defer to the model.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the architecture and technical direction of one or more services in our acquisition, extraction, and audit pipeline, and lead medium\-to\-large projects on them end to end
* Translate ambiguous problems into engineering\-ready designs, and decompose large efforts into pieces the team can build in parallel
* Act as a primary design and code reviewer — the second layer of judgment on AI\-assisted designs and pull requests, catching architectural drift and silent correctness defects early
* Set the bar for AI\-driven development on the squad — and bring your own view of what that should look like
* Own a category of reliability and technical\-debt work end to end, without derailing roadmap commitments
* Share in the squad's production support rotation for the services you own, and improve what pages us
* Mentor earlier\-career engineers: raise their design instincts, review quality, and independence
* Partner with Product, Operations, our Data Analytics Engineering team, and US\-based engineering counterparts to shape requirements and drive cross\-team initiatives


**What Will Help You Succeed**
****Must\-Haves****
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 8\+ years of software development experience at a SaaS or technology company, the majority building and operating backend or distributed systems in production
* A clear track record of owning projects end to end — from design through production — not just delivering assigned components
* Currently hands\-on. You have shipped production code within the last two years
* Experience with enterprise Java (Spring / Spring Boot preferred) and Python
* SQL and relational data modelling at depth — you have designed schemas that survived real growth, and debugged correctness problems in the data rather than only in the code
* Experience building and operating high\-volume data pipelines and third\-party integrations, where correctness matters as much as throughput
* Experience with event\-driven and asynchronous systems (streaming or queueing — Kinesis, Kafka, SQS or similar), including what goes wrong under retries and at\-least\-once delivery
* Deployed and operated systems on AWS or similar, on containerised platforms (Kubernetes / ECS)
* Production operability. You have owned services you were paged for — metrics and dashboards (Prometheus / Grafana, CloudWatch, Datadog or similar), structured logging, tracing, and alerts that fire on customer\-visible symptoms rather than on every anomaly
* Strong AI\-driven development practice. You work daily in agentic coding tools and are fluent at managing context and steering them across a large, unfamiliar codebase. AI is central to how this squad works, so you should already be ahead on it — with your own view of what good looks like and the judgment to know when the output isn't
* Architectural judgment. You can articulate the tradeoffs behind a design, choose the simpler option when it holds, and explain why you rejected the alternatives — including when the alternative came from a tool or from a more senior voice in the room
* Technical rigor. Testing strategy across the pyramid, observability and alerting built in rather than bolted on, security and maintainability treated as requirements
* Demonstrated mentorship. You've been the person a team goes to, and you've levelled others up
* Clear written and verbal communication. You write designs people can act on, and you work well with a distributed team across time zones
* Flexibility to join evening meetings up to \~8:30 PM IST to collaborate with US\-based counterparts


****Nice\-to\-Haves****
* Experience shipping AI/LLM\-backed features to production — latency, accuracy, cost, evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop design
* Experience building SQL data pipelines (Snowflake \+ dbt preferred)
* Experience in the energy industry, or another domain requiring deep knowledge of messy, unreliable source data

title: Software Development Engineer, Alexa Connections
description:
**Description**
 Alexa Connections is on a mission to become the world's most trusted communication agent, spanning across calls, text, email, and the ever\-expanding surfaces where people connect. We're building intelligence that keeps customers connected effortlessly to their network and beyond, while putting their trust and privacy first. As an Applied Scientist, you'll help build the smartest communications agent for people, an agent that understands intent, context, and relationships, and that acts on a customer's behalf to make every interaction feel effortless and genuinely helpful
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 You'll research and build the intelligence that helps people stay connected to the ones who matter. A central part of this is modeling each customer's personal connections graph, a privacy\-first representation of their relationships and communication patterns, and using it to power an assistant that is context\-aware and grows more helpful over time. You'll draw on large language models, agentic reasoning, and personalization to anticipate who, when, and how a customer wants to connect, and to act on their behalf across calls, text, and email. It's open\-ended research applied to a real product, turning advances in personalization and memory into an agent that genuinely understands the people in a customer's life.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We're building up the Alexa Connections science team, so you'll join early and grow alongside it. You'll work closely with experienced scientists and engineers invested in your development, with plenty of mentorship, room to broaden your skills, and the chance to own meaningful problems as you grow. It's a supportive place to do impactful work early in your career, shaping how millions of customers connect every day.

Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn U.S. taxation, a much sought\-after career option.
   

  

 At Deloitte, we are leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services and add greater impact to clients by combining technology and tax technical resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
   

  

 Work you’ll do
   

  

 We are looking for an innovative Technical SAP ABAP on HANA, CDS, OData, RAP Plus Gen AI develop and implement systems architecture that meet business needs, along with ensuring that our clients’ can keep pace with the changing tax and legal landscape.
   

  

 Design, build, and support performance SAP S/4HANA extensions and services using ABAP on HANA, RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP), Core Data Services (CDS), and OData to enable modern Fiori/UI and integration scenarios.
   

  

 To be successful in this role, you should be able to align the global Tax and Legal landscape with the business’ activities and proposed wider business processes. You will be the lynchpin between the Tax Function and IT Function, ensuring that we build the best SAP Tax design for the client. This will require the ability to explain complex terms to a variety of different stakeholders, and in a way that is relevant to each stakeholder group. You will also need to continually assess the SAP product suite and development roadmap to integrate any updated specifications and requirements into SAP system architecture.
   

  

 You will also need to integrate with the wider client project team (whether that is delivered by Deloitte Consulting or another Systems Integration partner). This will involve an understanding of how the tax design interacts with other process flows and also the inter\-personal skills to build the required relationships.
   

  

 Key responsibilities \-
   

  

 ü Develop and enhance ABAP solutions on SAP S/4HANA using clean, modular, and testable patterns.
   

  

 ü Build Gen AI applications and AI Agents.
   

  

 ü Code Python is a plus.
   

  

 ü Ability to navigate fragmented landscapes through API\-calls and MCP\- servers is key.
   

  

 ü Build end\-to\-end RAP artifacts (behavior definitions/implementations, validations, determinations, actions, draft handling, locking, authorization concepts).
   

  

 ü Create and optimize CDS views (interface/consumption views, associations, annotations) with strong focus on pushdown and performance.
   

  

 ü Design, expose, and support OData services (preferably OData V4 via RAP; maintain OData V4 where required).
   

  

 ü Implement Fiori\-enablement via CDS annotations and support UI integration with SAP Fiori elements (as applicable).
   

  

 ü Integrate with SAP and non\-SAP systems using SAP\-recommended patterns (e.g., APIs, events, messaging where applicable).
   

  

 ü Apply performance tuning (SQL optimization, buffering strategy, ST05/SAT/SQLM analysis, CDS performance best practices).
   

  

 ü Follow SAP extensibility guidelines (in\-app/extensibility, key\-user vs developer extensibility, released APIs, clean\-core approach where applicable).
   

  

 ü Produce technical designs, code documentation, unit tests, and participate in code reviews.
   

  

 ü Support testing cycles, defect triage, hyper care, and production support with strong root\-cause analysis
   

  

**Qualification And Experience Required \-**
 ü Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience).
   

  

 ü 2\-5 years of Experience in SAP or SAP4HANA.
   

  

 ü Hands\-on experience in building Gen AI applications, AI Agents.
   

  

 ü SAP Business AI certification is a plus.
   

  

 ü SAP certifications (ABAP for S/4HANA, RAP, BTP) are a plus.
   

  

 ü Strong hands\-on experience with ABAP in SAP S/4HANA / ABAP on HANA environments.
   

  

 ü Proven delivery experience with:
   

  

 ü RAP (managed/unmanaged as needed, behavior implementation, draft, authorization)
   

  

 ü CDS (views, annotations, associations, table functions if needed)
   

  

 ü OData service exposure and troubleshooting (RAP/OData V4 strongly preferred)
   

  

 ü Strong understanding of HANA\-optimized development: SQL/CDS pushdown, avoiding SELECT\-in\-loops, efficient joins, pagination, etc.
   

  

 ü Familiarity with modern ABAP practices (e.g., ABAP OO, clean code, exception handling, unit testing mindset).
   

  

 ü Experience working in Agile delivery (user stories, estimation, sprint ceremonies).
   

  

**ü Preferred / Nice To Have**
 ü SAP BTP exposure (e.g., Integration Suite, API Management, Event Mesh, ABAP environment/Steampunk—if relevant).
   

  

**Preferred \-**
 ü BTP, Joule and SAP business AI certification.
   

  

 ü Proven knowledge of Tax touchpoints within SAP.
   

  

 How you’ll grow
   

  

 At Deloitte, we’ve invested a great deal in creating a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills. And, as a part of our efforts, we provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities—including exposure to leaders, sponsors, coaches, and challenging assignments—to help accelerate their careers along the way. No two people learn in exactly the same way. So, we provide a range of resources including live classrooms, team\- based learning, and eLearning. DU: The Leadership Center in India, our state\-of\-the\-art, world\-class learning Center in the Hyderabad offices is an extension of the Deloitte University (DU) in Westlake, Texas, and represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to our people’s growth and development. \[1] Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.
   

  

 Deloitte supports your progression through a well\-defined career path by providing challenging assignments, mentoring, and targeted trainings. Recent post graduates begin as a consultant. The career path from there is to senior consultant, then manager, senior manager and onto a path to director or partner or principal.
   

  

 Deloitte’s culture
   

  

 Our positive and supportive culture encourages our people to do their best work every day. We celebrate individuals by recognizing their uniqueness and offering them the flexibility to make daily choices that can help them to be healthy, centered, confident, and aware. We offer well\-being programs and are continuously looking for new ways to maintain a culture that is inclusive, invites authenticity, leverages our diversity, and where our people excel and lead healthy, happy lives. \[2] Learn more about Life at Deloitte.
   

  

 Corporate citizenship
   

  

 Deloitte is led by a purpose: to make an impact that matters. This purpose defines who we are and extends to relationships with our clients, our people and our communities. We believe that business has the power to inspire and transform. We focus on education, giving, skill\-based volunteerism, and leadership to help drive positive social impact in our communities. \[3] Learn more about Deloitte’s impact on the world.

title: ML Engineer – Threat Detection Models
description:
**Location:** 
 India, Remote\-First
   

  

**Employment:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**Start Date:** 
 November 2026
   

  

**Experience:** 
 4\+ years
   

  

**Language:** 
 Fluent English required
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Cybersecurity / Enterprise SaaS / AI Security
   

  

**About The Opportunity**
 Pragmatike is recruiting on behalf of a global enterprise cybersecurity company building a new generation of products to secure
 **AI agents, LLM\-powered applications, and the data they access** 
 .
   

  

 The Threat Detection team builds the models that determine, in real time, whether a prompt, response, tool call, or piece of data presents a security risk, including
 **prompt injection, jailbreak attempts, sensitive data exposure, policy violations, and anomalous agent behavior** 
 .
   

  

 You'll own detection models end to end, from
 **data and training through evaluation and production serving** 
 , with models running inline in Go\-based gateway and endpoint services.
   

  

 We're looking for an ML Engineer who cares as much about
 **latency, reliability, and production performance** 
 as model quality, and who is comfortable working across both
 **Python and Go** 
 .
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Design, train, and evaluate threat detectors using classifiers, embedding\-based models, fine\-tuned LLMs, and rule/ML hybrid approaches.
* Build and maintain training and evaluation datasets, labeling workflows, and benchmark suites.
* Track model performance through precision/recall, error analysis, drift, and adversarial robustness.
* Serve models in production under strict latency requirements, working in Go to build inference services and integrate with gateway and endpoint pipelines.
* Optimize inference for performance and cost through techniques such as quantization, distillation, batching, and caching.
* Work closely with security researchers to turn emerging attack techniques into training data and detection logic.
* Build and maintain MLOps workflows covering reproducible training, model registries, monitoring, and safe model rollouts.
* Use AI\-assisted development workflows to accelerate implementation, testing, debugging, and experimentation.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

* 4\+ years of experience building and deploying ML models in production, including NLP or LLM\-based classification.
* Strong Python skills and experience with the modern ML stack, including PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, and scikit\-learn.
* Hands\-on experience fine\-tuning transformer\-based models.
* Solid Go skills, or strong backend engineering experience with the ability to become productive in Go quickly.
* Experience with low\-latency model serving, using technologies such as ONNX Runtime, TorchServe, Triton, vLLM, or custom serving infrastructure.
* Strong evaluation discipline, including dataset design, metrics, error analysis, and adversarial testing.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud provider.
* Fluent English with strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable using modern AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or similar. This is a must\-have.
* Strong ownership and the ability to work independently in a remote\-first, distributed environment.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience building detection systems for prompt injection, jailbreaks, or content safety.
* Experience with DLP or sensitive\-data classification, including PII, secrets, or source code.
* Familiarity with adversarial ML and model robustness techniques.
* Previous experience in cybersecurity, security tooling, or trust \& safety.
* Experience introducing AI\-assisted or agentic development workflows across engineering teams.


 AI\-First Engineering
   

  

 AI is a core part of the engineering workflow on this team.
   

  

 During the interview process, you'll be asked about how you use AI in real\-world software development, including the tools you use, how you validate their output, and where AI has changed the way you work.
   

  

 We're looking for engineers who use AI as a
 **force multiplier for quality, productivity, and problem\-solving** 
 , not simply as an autocomplete tool.
   

  

 Why Join
   

  

* Build real\-time AI threat detection systems at the intersection of cybersecurity and agentic AI.
* Take models from research and experimentation all the way into low\-latency production environments.
* Work on challenging problems spanning ML, LLM security, adversarial AI, and distributed systems.
* Own a critical detection workstream and influence how AI security threats are identified and mitigated.
* Collaborate with a highly technical, distributed team where AI is a core part of the development process.


 Pragmatike is committed to a fair, transparent, and inclusive recruitment process. We do not discriminate based on age, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.
   

  

 In accordance with GDPR, your personal data will be processed lawfully, fairly, and securely and used solely for recruitment purposes, including sharing it with our client(s) for employment consideration.

 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.

 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. **Role Overview:**
 As a Senior Cyber AI Engineer within EY's Global Delivery Services (GDS) Cybersecurity Team, you will drive the convergence of Cybersecurity, Vulnerability Management, and Artificial Intelligence to build intelligent, scalable, and automated security operations.
   

  

 You will design, implement, and enhance AI\-enabled vulnerability management programs that leverage machine learning, generative AI, intelligent analytics, and automation to improve risk identification, prioritization, remediation, and executive decision\-making across enterprise environments.
   

  

 In addition to delivering client engagements, you will help shape EY’s AI\-driven Cybersecurity capabilities, contribute to thought leadership, and mentor teams on applying AI responsibly and securely within cyber operations.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As organizations rapidly adopt AI and cloud\-native technologies, cybersecurity teams must evolve beyond traditional vulnerability management approaches. You will help clients transform their security operations by applying AI and data\-driven techniques to vulnerability management lifecycle
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 AI Security \& Guardrails
   

  

* Design, implement, and maintain enterprise AI security guardrails.
* Develop controls to mitigate prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, hallucinations, model abuse, and adversarial attacks.
* Define AI trust, safety, governance, and security standards.
* Evaluate AI applications against organizational security, privacy, and compliance requirements.
* Establish policies and enforcement mechanisms for responsible AI usage.
* Conduct security architecture reviews for AI applications, agents, and autonomous workflows.
* Define secure deployment patterns for LLM, RAG, and agent\-based solutions.
* Establish security logging, monitoring, and detection capabilities for AI systems.


 AI Red Teaming
   

  

* Conduct AI red team assessments against enterprise AI applications.
* Develop adversarial testing scenarios and attack simulations.
* Identify and document vulnerabilities and weaknesses within AI systems.
* Perform threat modeling for AI\-enabled business processes.
* Define remediation recommendations and compensating controls.
* Perform AI\-focused penetration testing against LLM, RAG, and agentic applications.
* Assess risks related to prompt injection, indirect prompt injection, tool manipulation, excessive agency, data poisoning, and model abuse.
* Execute threat\-informed adversarial simulations aligned to MITRE ATLAS and OWASP LLM guidance.


 Engineering \& Automation
   

  

* Develop Python\-based automation for AI security and testing workflows.
* Build APIs, integrations, and orchestration frameworks supporting AI evaluation efforts.
* Integrate testing and governance controls into CI/CD pipelines.
* Create dashboards and reporting capabilities that provide visibility into AI risk and performance.
* Integrate AI security controls into DevSecOps and Secure SDLC processes.
* Automate security validation, compliance verification, and security regression testing for AI applications.

* Application Security (OWASP Top 10\)
* Secure SDLC / DevSecOps
* Penetration Testing and Red Teaming
* Security Architecture Reviews
* Cloud Security
* Identity and Access Management
* Threat Detection and Monitoring
* Vulnerability Management

* MITRE ATLAS
* OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
* OWASP ASVS
* NIST AI Risk Management Framework
* NIST Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF)
* Secure AI Development and Governance Frameworks


**To Qualify for the Role**

* BE / BTech / MTech / MSc / MCA


**Experience**
* 4–8 years in Cybersecurity
* 2\+ years working with AI/ML or Security Automation initiatives
* Experience leading enterprise Vulnerability Management programs


**Preferred Certifications**

**What We Look For**
**Professionals who can bridge the gap between cybersecurity and artificial intelligence by:**
* Building AI\-enabled cyber defense solutions.
* Automating vulnerability and risk management processes.
* Driving next\-generation cyber transformation initiatives.


 The ideal candidate combines the mindset of a Security Architect, Vulnerability Management Leader and AI Engineer to create intelligent, scalable, and resilient cybersecurity VM programs.
   

  

**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits**

title: Cloud AI Security - Manager
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Cyber**
 Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever\-changing threat design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.
   

  

**Job Title:** 
 Manager \- Cloud AI Security
   

  

 Are you interested in working in a dynamic environment that offers opportunities for professional growth and new responsibilities? If so, Deloitte could be the place for you. Traditional security programs have often been unsuccessful in unifying the need to both secure and support technology innovation required by the business. Join Deloitte's Cyber Cloud AI Security team and become a member of the largest group of cybersecurity professionals worldwide.
   

  

**Work you’ll do**
 As a Cloud AI Security Manager, you will lead client engagements focused on securing AI, generative AI, and ML workloads across cloud platforms. You will help clients define and implement secure AI strategies, architectures, governance models, and control frameworks across the AI lifecycle, including data ingestion, model development, validation, deployment, runtime monitoring, and retraining. You will be expected to lead engagement delivery, manage senior client stakeholders, guide cross\-functional teams, mentor junior practitioners, and drive high\-quality outcomes across AI security, cloud security, governance, compliance, and risk management.
   

  

 Responsibilities as a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant will include:
   

  

* Lead client engagements focused on AI, GenAI, and ML security across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud environments.
* Lead the design and implementation of AI security solutions aligned to client business objectives, enterprise architecture, regulatory expectations, and security requirements.
* Oversee AI security assessments for cloud\-hosted AI/ML and GenAI workloads, evaluating controls against frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, CSA CCM, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001\.
* Lead threat modeling, architecture reviews, and control design for AI and GenAI solutions, including risks related to prompt injection, jailbreaks, insecure output handling, excessive agent permissions, sensitive data exposure, model misuse, and insecure tool or connector use.
* Define secure AI reference architectures spanning model endpoints, APIs, retrieval pipelines, vector stores, plugins, agent frameworks, orchestration layers, and external integrations.
* Guide secure deployment and configuration of cloud\-native AI services including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, and Google Vertex AI.
* Oversee implementation of platform\-specific controls such as private connectivity, encryption, key management, secrets management, access restrictions, tenant isolation, content safety controls, and service\-native logging and monitoring.
* Lead DevSecOps, MLOps, and MLSecOps integration by embedding security checks, policy validation, secrets handling, model governance, and compliance controls into CI/CD and ML pipelines.
* Establish secure AI lifecycle controls across data ingestion, training, validation, deployment, runtime monitoring, incident response, drift review, and retraining.
* Lead AI governance and compliance activities including model inventory, risk classification, approval workflows, traceability, control mapping, audit readiness, and policy alignment.
* Drive AI security posture management using cloud\-native tooling, CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, and related capabilities to identify misconfiguration, data exposure, anomalous activity, and policy violations.
* Oversee AI\-specific monitoring and incident response capabilities for suspicious prompt behavior, agent misuse, unauthorized model access, data leakage, and control failures.
* Lead or coordinate AI security testing activities including misuse\-case testing, prompt attack validation, model guardrail reviews, red\-team support, and remediation planning.
* Manage client stakeholders across security, cloud engineering, DevOps, architecture, data, ML engineering, privacy, legal, and risk teams.
* Lead teams of analysts, consultants, and senior consultants by assigning work, reviewing outputs, coaching team members, and ensuring quality of delivery.
* Contribute to business development, proposals, solutioning, thought leadership, reusable assets, and practice development initiatives related to cloud AI security.


**The team**
 Deloitte Cyber team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated cyber risks. Our professionals provide advisory and implementation services that integrate risk, regulatory, and technology skills to help clients transform their legacy programs into proactive cyber risk programs. Join the team developing the future state of cyber risk solutions. Learn more about Deloitte Advisory’s Cyber Risk Services practice.
   

  

**Required:**
* 9\+ years of experience in cloud security, cybersecurity consulting, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, AI security, or related disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience leading client\-facing engagements or major workstreams in security, cloud, or AI\-related programs.
* Experience designing, assessing, or implementing security controls for cloud\-hosted applications, platforms, and AI/ML environments.
* Strong experience with one or more major cloud platforms, with working knowledge across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML and GenAI security concepts, including prompt injection, model misuse, data leakage, secure model access, agent security, model governance, and responsible AI controls.
* Experience implementing cloud security controls across IAM, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and policy enforcement.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Bash, and PowerShell.
* Experience with DevSecOps, CI/CD, and secure engineering practices, including policy validation, secrets handling, and continuous compliance.
* Familiarity with cloud AI services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure OpenAI, Mythos, Anthropic, and Vertex AI.
* Familiarity with governance and security frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, and related control frameworks.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience communicating technical and risk matters to executive and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience leading teams, mentoring junior practitioners, and managing quality across client deliverables.


**Preferred:**
* Experience leading AI security assessments, architecture reviews, control design, remediation programs, or transformation initiatives across one or more major cloud platforms.
* Deep hands\-on experience with identity and access management, including AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, and Google Cloud IAM.
* Experience designing governance and guardrails for cloud AI environments using services such as AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, Azure Policy, Security Command Center, and equivalent policy enforcement capabilities.
* Experience with cloud\-native monitoring and security tooling such as AWS Security Hub, CloudTrail, AWS Config, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, and Google Security Command Center.
* Experience with CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, vulnerability management, container security, and posture management tools supporting AI workloads.
* Experience with prompt security, content safety, model guardrails, AI runtime monitoring, and agent security for generative AI applications.
* Exposure to AI red teaming, misuse\-case testing, prompt attack validation, or adversarial testing of LLM\-enabled applications.
* Experience securing containerized, API\-driven, and agent\-based AI applications.
* Knowledge of privacy, legal, and data governance considerations relevant to AI workloads, including data residency, retention, sensitive data handling, and auditability.
* Experience establishing AI governance processes such as AI inventory, model classification, approval gates, traceability, documentation standards, and audit support.
* Experience contributing to proposals, solution development, go\-to\-market offerings, and practice\-building activities.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, Microsoft Azure security certifications, or comparable senior\-level cloud and security credentials.


**How You’ll Grow**

From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there’s always room to learn. We offer well\-being programs and are continuously looking for new ways to maintain a culture where our people excel and lead healthy, happy lives. Learn more about Life at Deloitte.
   

  

**Corporate citizenship**
 Deloitte is led by a purpose: to make an impact that matters. This purpose defines who we are and extends to relationships with our clients, our people and our communities. We believe that business has the power to inspire and transform. We focus on education, giving, skill\-based volunteerism, and leadership to help drive positive social impact in our communities. To help you with your interview, we suggest that you do your research: know some background about the organization and the business area you’re applying to. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte professionals.

 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people.
